news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 3: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 3 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 24 los angeles chargers 16 cleveland browns 21 carolina panthers 18 detroit lions 31 new york jets 24 indianapolis colts 19 houston texans 17 jacksonville jaguars 35 new england patriots 6 kansas city chiefs 24 miami dolphins 10 new york giants 12 tennessee titans 7 pittsburgh steelers 30 cincinnati bengals 27 washington commanders 33 seattle seahawks 31 late window arizona cardinals at san francisco 49ers minnesota vikings at tampa bay buccaneers las vegas raiders at new orleans saints baltimore ravens at dallas cowboys sunday night los angeles rams at denver broncos nick shook s analysis to come back to top nick shook s analysis to come back to top kevin patra s takeaways gibbs lions offense powers win over jets jahmyr gibbs did his best barry sanders impression carrying detroit to a win with jukes galore the stud running back scored three second half touchdowns starting with a 17 yard against the grain jaunt in which no 0 pulled off a no 20 imitation gibbs was a mismatch against the jets older linebackers in the passing attack repeatedly finding space in the open field he finished with 99 rushing yards and two scores on 20 carries plus seven catches for 65 yards and the game winning td gibbs ability to gash defenses on the outside while also muscling for short yardage games shows complete back ability his talent as a pass catcher makes him unstoppable powered by gibbs the lions offense moved up and down the field for the final three quarters scoring on five of six drives they avoided a three and out all day while putting up 30 plus points for the third time in three weeks to open the season jets battle but come up short geno smith and the offense needed time to kick things into gear after going three and out in two of the first three drives smith diced up the lions secondary displaying good pocket acumen and a willingness to sit in and take a hit smith threw for 321 yards on 31 of 37 with three tds the jets took advantage of their tight end matchups rookie kenyon sadiq had the best game of his young career proving to be a good outlet with good hands and the ability to dust lbs he finished with 105 yards and his first career receiving td on seven catches sacks stymied the jets offense early but the offensive line cleaned things up in the second half allowing the jets to tie the game late after falling behind 14 0 then the lions threw a big blitz and chuck clark got away clean and sacked smith who fumbled with a chance to score late once again the jets showed they can compete the next step is turning close losses into actual wins lions d makes a late play after struggling to slow the jets kelvin sheppard dialed up a blitz that confused the jets blocking and allowed clark to come up with the game sealing strip it s a good thing chuck clark made the play because detroit s defense once again showed an inability to get a stop in the second half with defensive backs getting burned so often the pass rush rarely gets a chance to get to the quarterback when the defensive line is blocked up it s almost assuredly a big play for the opponent former jet d j reed continues to struggle getting picked on and racking up defensive interference calls reed versus garrett wilson was a clear mismatch when a team s most veteran cb is a liability it s going to be a problem at this stage the defense s hope is to get just enough stops while the offense keeps racking up points it s a defense that requires a near perfect offense to rack up ws next gen stats insight for lions jets via nfl pro the jets blitzed jared goff on 44 4 of his dropbacks with goff completing all 14 of his attempts for 148 yards and a touchdown when facing extra rushers 27 8 cpoe goff also fared well on play action completing 11 of 13 attempts for 181 yards nfl research with his two rushing touchdowns in week 3 jahmyr gibbs 43 passed billy sims 42 for the second most rushing touchdowns in lions franchise history trailing only hall of famer barry sanders 99 gibbs also recorded his fifth career game with three touchdowns tying hof jim brown and todd gurley for the most three plus td games by a player before turning 25 in nfl history his seven career games with 150 plus scrimmage yards and multiple scrimmage touchdowns trail only hall of famers jim brown 11 barry sanders nine and walter payton eight for most by a player under the age of 25 in nfl history back to top bobby kownack s analysis to come back to top dan parr s takeaways jaguars dominated jacksonville never trailed on sunday and it didn t relent when new england s miscues piled up it seems a healthy sign for the jags that they didn t simply survive against the sloppy patriots they buried the reigning afc champions the offense bounced back after disappearing in the second half against the broncos last week with trevor lawrence throwing touchdown passes to three different players lawrence now has 105 career passing tds surpassing blake bortles for second in franchise history it was particularly encouraging to see the offensive line perform much better than it did against denver the pats were down some starters on defense and lawrence did throw an interception for the second week in a row but jacksonville had put the game out of reach by the third quarter liam coen has a legitimate chance to be the first head coach to lead the jaguars to consecutive playoff appearances in the current millennium nightmarish day for maye the vibes around drake maye have not been lower since he was drafted third overall in 2024 he threw two interceptions including one in the end zone that killed a patriots drive also he lost a fumble when the ball slipped out of his hand as he reached back to pass in the first quarter the jaguars scored a td on the ensuing possession and new england never recovered suffering its most lopsided loss since mike vrabel was hired as head coach prior to the 2025 season in a sign of just how bad things were on sunday vrabel sat maye for the second half of the fourth quarter inserting backup tommy devito at quarterback with the game out of reach a j brown ankle is still weeks away from returning and a trip to face the division leading bills awaits so things are not about to get easier for vrabel s squad hunter is on the board travis hunter the second overall pick of the 2025 nfl draft finally has his first career interception picking off drake maye in the second quarter on a pass to the end zone intended for efton chism it s been a bumpy ride for hunter in the nfl due in large part to the injury that ended his rookie year in week 7 and the team s struggle to maximize his ability as a two way player he played a season high 42 snaps on defense in week 3 and perhaps sunday s int will be a new beginning of sorts for the franchise s massive investment next gen stats insight for patriots jaguars via nfl pro the jaguars generated pressure on 58 4 of drake maye s dropbacks the third highest pressure rate he has faced in the regular season against pressure maye went 6 of 11 for 81 yards and an interception without pressure he went 8 of 14 for 118 yards and an interception nfl research drake maye s seven turnovers are the most by a patriots player in the team s first three games of a season over the last 30 years back to top bobby kownack s takeaways chiefs score ho hum win although kansas city hardly felt in danger of losing this was more of a slow developing victory for the chiefs than their fans probably would ve liked patrick mahomes found completions pretty much wherever he wanted going 20 of 24 for 246 yards two touchdowns and a tipped interception but it didn t result in opening up a sizeable lead until late the pick was partly to blame for that as was a turnover on downs at midfield during the drive preceding it and while it s difficult to harp on flaws after a defense forced two turnovers and only allowed 10 points the group s performance didn t feel dominant in a way that the week 1 victory over the broncos was the chiefs let the dolphins hang around until late allowing numerous extended drives even if several ultimately proved fruitless mansoor delane did look good coming off his shoulder injury he had 10 tackles and a pass deflection while allowing just 24 yards on nine targets nick bolton was also all over the place with a game high 11 tackles and chris jones tipped a malik willis pass in the air for a george karlaftis interception to end any hopes of a miami comeback perhaps wanting more after a double digit win is a sign the super bowl contending chiefs are back though fins hang tough on both sides the final score does not indicate just how hard the dolphins fought to stay in the game until the very end kansas city didn t pull ahead by more than one possession until just under three minutes remained although the dolphins offense scored under 14 points for a third straight week the unit represented itself well while undermanned due to injuries the team s leading receiver caleb douglas missed sunday s action due to an ankle injury and running back de 39 von achane injured his knee on miami s first drive but miami nonetheless was able to sustain a handful of lengthy marches on the same possession achane went down the dolphins went 91 yards on 17 plays for a touchdown miami s first three possessions in the second half also took at least nine plays even if it didn t result in a win the dolphins ability to play keep away from patrick mahomes winning the time of possession by nearly nine minutes and ending with just 5 fewer total net yards than the chiefs was admirable malik willis was a bit more open to rushing than the previous two weeks with 56 yards on nine carries which helped keep kansas city off balance the qb also got chris bell as involved as he s been yet hitting the rookie four times for a team leading 67 yards defensively the dolphins buckled down after looking anemic allowing two straight td drives to open the game they didn t allow another point from kansas city until the fourth quarter keeping the score in reach with a forced turnover on downs and jacob rodriguez first career interception it s still a loss for the 0 3 dolphins but the process looked promising for a rebuilding squad kwiii continues to deliver it wasn t as electric as his two 100 yard rushing games to kick off his chiefs tenure but kenneth walker was again the sparkplug for kansas city s offense against the dolphins he scored the team s first two touchdowns a 10 yard run up the gut of miami s defense and a 5 yard reception on an underhand toss from patrick mahomes walker did surprisingly get stuffed on a fourth down in the second quarter and was held to a season low 3 9 yards per carry but a lot of credit belongs to miami s penetration he was still making plenty of his opportunities with three runs of 10 plus yards and 16 rushing yards over expected as he finished with 70 yards on 18 attempts that brings the tough running walker to 360 rushing yards already on the season with another 82 receiving he has completely changed the complexion of the chiefs offense in just three short games next gen stats insight for chiefs dolphins via nfl pro kenneth walker forced 12 missed tackles in the running game against the dolphins the third time that walker forced 12 or more missed tackles on carries in a game this season nfl research patrick mahomes picked up his 98th career win breaking a tie with tom brady for the third most quarterback wins in a player s first 10 seasons since quarterback starts were tracked in 1950 the only quarterbacks with more than mahomes are peyton manning 105 and russell wilson 104 with mahomes still having 14 games remaining in his 10th season back to top jeremy bergman s analysis to come back to top brooke cersosimo s analysis to come back to top kevin patra s analysis to come back to top brooke cersosimo s analysis to come back to top kevin patra s analysis to come back to top nick shook s analysis to come back to top dan parr s analysis to come back to top grant gordon s analysis to come back to top

news_mentions.headline: Ravens vs. Cowboys: Three must-know storylines for NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro
news_mentions.description: Is Ravens RB Derrick Henry about to run over the Cowboys once again? Jeremy Bergman breaks down three must-know storylines for Sunday's game between Baltimore and Dallas in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back in brazil this week for the third straight season once again pitting two high profile clubs in front of some of the world s most passionate fans it s a recipe for electric football but there are a few notable differences this time around for one after two years in sao paulo the league is making its regular season debut in brazil s second largest city rio de janeiro and its most iconic venue the maracana home to some of the most memorable moments in brazilian sporting history two world cups with unfortunate exits for the selecao the 2016 summer olympics the maracana used to hold nearly 200 000 spectators jerry jones cowboys who play in one of the nfl s largest stadiums will feel right at home in the cavernous confines the capacity is just over 73 000 nowadays but the roar undoubtedly remains another change after being played in friday week 1 island windows in 2024 and 25 this year s brazil game will kick off at 4 25 p m et on a sunday right in the middle of a four game late slate no offense to the cardinals 49ers vikings buccaneers raiders and saints but most eyes will be on baltimore and dallas in rio and deservedly so boasting two of the most explosive offenses and marketable quarterbacks in today s nfl the ravens and cowboys enter their international outing with somewhat disappointing 1 1 records and a lot to prove after a week 1 road rout of indianapolis baltimore blew a second half lead at home against the saints in week 2 the cowboys conversely were run over by the rival giants in week 1 only to crush the visiting commanders the following sunday both considered playoff division and super bowl contenders baltimore and dallas have a lot to work out in the season s early goings and will be doing so this week in unfamiliar territory the ravens are playing only their third ever game overseas while the cowboys will be embarking on just their second international voyage three must know storylines 1 is derrick henry due for another big day vs dallas d tractorcito bem vindo ao brasil the ravens running back hulking at 6 foot 3 and 252 pounds is set up for a monster day at the maracana as long as baltimore leans on the back in crunch time through two weeks henry ranked second in the league with 212 rushing yards while tying for the nfl lead with four scores on the ground the tailback might have been even more productive if he had received more than five carries in the second half of the ravens week 2 loss when the saints came back from an 11 point first half deficit the perfect remedy after last week s disappointing finish could be a date with the cowboys defense led by first year dc christian parker dallas hasn t stopped a nosebleed through two weeks ranking 29th in yards allowed per game 391 5 and 30th in rushing yards allowed per game 173 5 the cowboys are also dead last in third down conversion rate allowed 68 0 a bruiser like henry and an escape artist like lamar jackson are nightmares for a defense like dallas which struggled to contain cam skattebo and jaxson dart in week 1 allowing the giants to control the clock and salt away a win while the cowboys offense had two second half possessions just two years ago henry rolled over dallas to the tune of 174 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns with jackson tallying 87 yards and a td on the ground as well will the ravens runners have similar outings in the southern hemisphere this sunday 2 can the cowboys continue to roll offensively if week 1 was a liar as they say was week 2 the truth for the cowboys it s tough to say this early in the season with dallas jekyll and hyde offense the cowboys scored on seven of their eight drives against washington in their home opener and have consistently cooked defenses under brian schottenheimer all of which made their season opening dud in east rutherford see 244 total yards all the more surprising after the ravens struggled to defend through the air against chris olave juwan johnson and devaughn vele in week 2 dallas will look to hammer baltimore s dbs with a heavy dose of ceedee lamb and george pickens a dynamic duo that only occasionally has a case of the dropsies and tight end jake ferguson the key for the ravens will be getting pressure on dak prescott so far this season the qb has been beating the blitz with ease 78 3 completion percentage third in nfl but when under pressure he has struggled 50 his lowest mark since 2019 per nfl pro baltimore s defense boasts a 43 8 pressure rate this season the fifth highest in the nfl and has pressured qbs on 65 0 of third down dropbacks highest in the league if dallas can avoid third and long situations it may have a field day against baltimore but jesse minter s defense led by kyle hamilton roquan smith trey hendrickson and potentially nnamdi madubuike who might make his season debut on sunday will do its best to keep the cowboys behind the chains 3 play action advantage for baltimore playing off its success in the ground game baltimore could enjoy a big day in the play fake game against dallas through two games this season lamar jackson has completed 13 of his 18 play action pass attempts for an nfl high 229 yards while also taking off to run on four play action dropbacks for 36 scramble rush yards the top total in the league off play action per nfl pro meanwhile his opponent on sunday has allowed qbs to target a receiver with 3 plus yards of separation on 12 of 17 play action attempts this season 70 6 the second highest rate in the nfl and has also yielded a league high 61 scramble yards on play action dropbacks 24 more than the next closest team while jackson is making fewer plays on designed runs this year he remains the nfl s great improviser the dallas defense is determined to stay disciplined but with the unit struggling against play action baltimore s two time league mvp could break open the game either through the air or on the ground total football in brazil s cathedral of futebol

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs want to lighten Kenneth Walker's workload after 56 touches in two games
news_mentions.description: Kenneth Walker III has rejuvenated the Kansas City offense, bringing a tackle-breaking ground element that had been missing. The Chiefs, however, know they mustn’t grind the RB into the ground.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth walker has rejuvenated the kansas city chiefs offense bringing a tackle breaking ground element that had been missing the chiefs however know they mustn t grind the rb into the ground coach andy reid said this week the club would like to reduce walker s workload a little bit heading into week 3 walker led the nfl with 290 rushing yards and 369 scrimmage yards in 2026 two touchdowns after thursday night football bijan robinson now leads with 349 and 467 respectively walker s rushing yard tally marks the most by any nfl player through two weeks since c j spiller in 2012 292 walker is on pace for 2 465 rush yards which would be an nfl record by 360 yards he s also tied with jahmyr gibbs with 56 scrimmage touches we re lucky to have him running backs coach demarco murray said thursday via espn he s a great leader and he s done a great job for us he s prepared himself for this workload since the spring coach reid puts a great training camp together and the long drive drill is legendary around here walker likes the ball a lot walker s 369 scrimmage yards are the second most by a player in his first two games with a team in the super bowl era only billy sims had more with the lions the back has forced 29 missed tackles in 2026 per next gen stats most through two weeks in ngs era the key is balance and ensuring walker who never played a full 17 game slate before last season remains healthy to that end the chiefs plan to give rookie emmett johnson who has also flashed tackle breaking acumen more run we just want to continue to make sure we re bringing our rookies along the right way offensive coordinator eric bieniemy said thursday emmett s role is to continue to grow as the season progresses what you don t want to do when you re raising some of these young players is put them in a situation where it could be detrimental to them you want them feeling free and confident through two games johnson has generated 10 rushes for 39 yards and four catches for 64 yards 103 scrimmage yards the plan is to get the rookie more carries starting with sunday s game against the miami dolphins i want kenneth to get into a groove and it s hard to kind of take him out murray said but emmett s done a great job and he s still learning he ll continue to get more opportunities i ve just got to pull the trigger and get no 9 walker out of there and put no 10 johnson in there

news_mentions.headline: Packers coach Matt LaFleur: 'Butt-whooping' from Falcons was 'humbling'
news_mentions.description: The Green Bay Packers got bullied by a previously 0-2 Atlanta Falcons squad, 35-14, as the Lambeau Field fans rained down boos.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay is no stranger to dense flurries usually they don t come in september and usually those squalls aren t of the vociferous nature from locals fed up with the football team thursday night packers fans showered their club with boos during an embarrassing 35 14 loss to the atlanta falcons well that was a humbling night coach matt lafleur said certainly i don t think anybody is pleased about this and you know we ve got a couple extra days here and everybody s got to take a long hard look at themselves and we ve got to find solutions and just come back ready to work but it certainly was a tough night tough doesn t begin to describe the ugly watch as the packers gave up 27 unanswered points at one point lafleur s offense couldn t move the ball the defense couldn t stop bijan robinson or drake london green bay made a previously 0 2 falcons squad look like the 89 niners it was a butt whooping lafleur noted i m not going to put it on one thing certainly we definitely have to respond better but that was at least three quarters of butt whooping right there atlanta lost 34 3 at home to the carolina panthers on sunday was the return of michael penix worth a 52 point swing the quarterback certainly got kevin stefanski s offense motoring without the clutch crippling miscues from qb3 and qb4 who played in the first two games thursday s tilt however said much more about the packers than the falcons lafleur s squad is a mismanaged game by jets coach aaron glenn from starting 0 3 green bay has lost two of its first three games by at least 17 points in 2026 it is the first time the packers have lost multiple games by 17 points in an entire season since 2017 their 21 point loss in week 3 versus the falcons is their largest home loss in prime time since week 5 2004 against steve mcnair and the titans lost 48 27 their 35 point differential in 2026 is their worst through three games since 1988 the defense has struggled to get stops on thursday the packers missed a trove of tackles and the back end got burned when they stepped up to try to slow robinson more concerning is an offense playing as if it s in quicksand the shuffled offensive line is a mess it can t pass block or open holes the running game is cripplingly bad with rbs who miss holes rarely break tackles or try to bounce everything outside and jordan love has been an inaccurate disaster whether the pressure has gotten to the qb who entered his fourth year as a starter or he s simply panicking love s play has been dismal through three games love was pressured 23 times 41 8 pressure rate in week 3 against the falcons completing eight of 21 pass attempts for 71 yards and one interception to start the season love has been pressured on 42 1 of his dropbacks completing just 18 passes under pressure for 47 yards and two interceptions the lack of a rushing attack has been a problem it was a surprise during the offseason that green bay didn t do more to bolster the rb room given josh jacobs legal quandary with the veteran on the commissioner s exempt list that problem has been exacerbated the packers rushed for 17 total yards on nine carries on thursday the falcons had three runs of at least 16 yards i think we ve got to continue to work with these guys and try to figure out what we do well because right now i don t know what we re doing well offensively lafleur admitted it was obvious to the home fans who booed the packers play relentlessly tight end tucker kraft who suffered several drops took issue with the green bay fanatics voicing their negative opinion that s pretty tough like everyone pictures lambeau field and not boos kraft said via matt schneidman of the athletic i don t picture boos i picture my home stadium that s tough it s pretty disappointing especially for a home opener it s pretty disappointing it s not going to help us win like i don t know what people think that s going to rally us or something like that but that s we re grown men we re mentally strong enough capable enough to get back on the field and play ball but it d probably much easier with the 70 000 people behind us rather than opposing us the loyalty of packers fans is unquestioned if they re booing it s because the product is not up to the level of excellence the organization has established blind support is for sheep the extra few days before the packers take the field again in tampa bay are as pivotal a stretch as lafleur has faced in his tenure in green bay

news_mentions.headline: Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett defends Marvin Harrison Jr. amid criticism of slow start
news_mentions.description: Cardinals WR Marvin Harrison has just one catch through two games to start the season. QB Jacoby Brissett defended the wideout when talking to reporters on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: arizona cardinals wide receiver marvin harrison is now in year three of his nfl career and is still hearing the same questions why aren t you more involved in the offense where are the big plays we were promised through two games this season harrison has seen just four targets he s caught one a fantastic snag down the sideline in week 1 for 33 yards production that doesn t match his status as the no 4 overall pick in the 2024 draft pressed for answers after seeing just one target in arizona s lopsided week 2 loss to seattle harrison explained it as a matter of circumstance it s definitely a combination of a lot of things harrison told reporters on wednesday via espn for my route tree getting down the field you need a lot of things to go right you need the right coverage you need protection to hold up you need me to run a great route you need obviously jacoby brissett to make the right pass and make the right read so i feel like it s never one person s fault for anybody s success or lack thereof really so i think it s always a combination of a bunch of things and whether that s a lack of success or success in general it doesn t help that despite spotty at best production harrison is seen as arizona s most dangerous threat in the cardinals receiving corps which will draw additional attention from opposing defenses in arizona s week 1 win over the chargers los angeles only left him on an island in single coverage on seven of the 33 routes he ran he won his only press man matchup a situation in which his size and route running gives him an advantage on the sideline grab his lone contribution to arizona s season opening highlight reel brissett meanwhile leaned heavily on tight end trey mcbride in both games capitalizing on coverage mismatches to the tune of nine completions for 95 yards and a touchdown in week 1 in their low output week 2 contest mcbride was arizona s passing offense logging the most targets 10 and catches 8 for 41 yards and his second touchdown of the season it s clear brissett prefers the playmaking tight end as a reliable target but harrison still looms as a big play threat if given the opportunities which were sparse in their 31 7 loss to the defensively driven reigning champions this past sunday pretty much that simple harrison said seattle s a really good defense and you don t want to give a lot of teams especially a rival team a lot of credit but when you just look across the league they re far beyond above everybody else especially on the defensive side of the football so things like that happen if it were the first slow start for harrison folks might give him grace but through two seasons and the first two weeks of 2026 harrison s productivity hasn t come close to matching his expectations previous struggles were partially pinned on arizona s instability at quarterback with kyler murray s health challenges limiting his availability and hindering their chances of establishing a rapport defensive minded coach jonathan gannon s presence also gave cardinals an easy excuse now though the underwhelming performances are rising to a concerning level coach mike lafleur brings the offensive expertise for which cardinals fans previously yearned yet the initial returns remain the same for harrison he hears the criticism fortunately he also has the support of his quarterback is some of the noise justified brissett said i don t think so personally we just signed mike wilson for 25 million and nobody said anything about him having two catches i think people try to find somewhere to make something out of nothing the only thing you can do is just go out there and just continue to get better as a teammate of him and him as an individual and i think that s what we re doing harrison is no stranger to the spotlight he arrived at ohio state as a top recruit succeeded stars garrett wilson chris olave and jaxon smith njigba the 2025 nfl offensive player of the year in columbus and knew he d be a top pick in the 2024 nfl draft he just hasn t delivered on those expectations yet no he said when asked if he was surprised by the public reaction to his slow start i mean i understand who i am and what i was expected to do when i got drafted here and all the expectations that were put on me and i think people want certain production so when that s not happening everybody s going to ask questions or figure out why is that the reason and so i wouldn t say i m surprised by anything that s talked about me anyway fortunately he still has 15 more games this season to prove them wrong

news_mentions.headline: Chargers QB Justin Herbert rejects leadership concerns: 'I trust those guys in that locker room'
news_mentions.description: When a team starts 0-2, it’s easy to blindly pin blame on the quarterback. That’s what’s happening in Los Angeles, where Justin Herbert's winless Chargers are fighting off talk of catastrophe and their leadership is being questioned.
news_mentions.body_text: when a team starts 0 2 it s easy to blindly pin blame on the quarterback that s what s happening in los angeles where the winless chargers are fighting off talk of catastrophe and their leadership is being questioned that specific query is what set off justin herbert on wednesday i think that happens regardless i think our team is so close and so i don t think there s a lack of vocal leadership at all an especially stern herbert said when asked if the team lacked a vocal leader so i think i m going to stop you right there and say that it s very present we ve got great leadership on this team i trust those guys in that locker room and so i don t think anyone is panicked or worried because that s not going to do us any good it s moving on to the next play and understanding we re close we ve made mistakes how do we fix them how do we move on mistakes have been plentiful for the chargers who have committed 15 accepted penalties for 109 yards and given away possession five times in two games those numbers don t account for the dropped passes either like the sharp throw from herbert that tight end david njoku bobbled into the hands of las vegas raiders cornerback hezekiah masses in week 2 simply the chargers have been an operational mess through two weeks herbert has had his positive moments but he too has made mistakes unnecessarily forcing passes in winnable games that have resulted in tide turning interceptions the upgraded offense that was supposed to come with the arrival of coordinator mike mcdaniel has failed to materialize and los angeles has scored just 28 points in two games i think anytime you learn a new offense um you re gonna have times where you re gonna just want to do your best and make sure that you re doing everything you can to be at your best herbert said so no i think every nfl offense is a complicated one but i think it s just on us to be studying our stuff making sure that we re ready to go the last line in herbert s response is intriguing if not illuminating the chargers have appeared anything but prepared to start this season getting outplayed and outcoached by an underdog arizona cardinals team that rolled into sofi stadium in week 1 and gleefully punched the bolts in the mouth the raiders enjoyed similar success in week 2 capitalizing on busted coverages poor discipline and even worse execution that made them look like the superior team too it s incredibly far from the standard coach jim harbaugh has set in los angeles since he arrived in 2024 and with the chargers schedule significantly increasing in difficulty starting in week 3 the pressure is on i think it s just about us being at our best learning and continuing to get better doing what we re coached to to be at our best herbert said they ll need to be at their peak sunday when they head to buffalo to face the red hot bills otherwise herbert will field more of the same frustrating questions again next week

news_mentions.headline: Giants' Jameis Winston returns to starting QB role after Jaxson Dart injury: 'This is what I dream of'
news_mentions.description: The New York Giants are now Jameis Winston’s team. After being called into emergency action on Monday night in Los Angeles, Winston has a game to prepare for.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants are now jameis winston s team it s a product of unfortunate circumstances usual starter jaxson dart suffered a knee injury that will require surgery but there s little time to waste on acknowledging misfortune after being called into emergency action on monday night in los angeles winston has a game to prepare for this is what i ve always dreamed of to be a starting quarterback winston told reporters wednesday ahead of new york s week 3 matchup with tennessee obviously my respects and gratitude is just going to be with jaxson but at the same time this is what i dream of i dream of being what i am right now and executing at a high level winston certainly didn t execute at a high level when he replaced the injured dart on monday night completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception in the 28 6 defeat he s been here before though starting in place of dart for two games last season that both ended in one score losses winston s experience and performance in spot starts convinced the giants to reward him with a two year 13 million extension earlier in september securing a veteran backup they can trust they just didn t expect to have to turn to him so quickly that s life in the nfl as a backup quarterback though and after being one play away from seeing the field winston can count on it for the rest of the regular season it s truly a privilege he said i had this privilege for two games last year it truly was an honor but for this game alone my focus is on being my very best going out there and having elite fundamentals and precise execution and that s what it starts with and it s as simple as that no matter how big it may seem being present and focused on doing all that you can do with what you have with where you are for right now that s keeping jaxson s spirits uplifted and going out there on that football field and being the new york football giants starting quarterback right now winston is a guaranteed manufacturer of fun playing a wild and often reckless style of quarterback with the arm talent and athleticism to produce big plays the former no 1 pick also comes with what is essentially a guarantee to commit crushing mistakes at the worst possible times as the founder of the 30 30 club 30 touchdowns 30 interceptions thrown in a single season winston s unpredictability has defined his career he s liable to throw for 400 yards but he s just as likely to throw three interceptions or a game losing pick six he did all three as a member of the browns in a 2024 loss to denver winston once even called to the heavens for help after throwing an interception returned for a touchdown telling reporters he was praying for the lord to deliver me from pick sixes the giants will want him to be himself but also keep things between the lines it s their best chance of overcoming the loss of dart and proving themselves as a competitive team worthy of new york s support the fans want to see wins winston said it s not about what i m showing them it s about us going out there and winning football games together giving them something to cheer for giving them something to stand behind but right now my heart this is fresh the opportunity is beautiful it s amazing i m grateful for it but at the same time i ve got a brother that i ve got to keep lifted up and i have to prepare for a football game but i ve prepared for many football games and i ve dealt with injury before i ve had an injury that was really bad so balancing the two but keeping a perspective of do what you can with what you have right now where you re at winston and the giants 1 1 host the titans 0 2 on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? Plus, three disappointing units
news_mentions.description: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks provides game plans for two of the NFL's toughest assignments. Plus, three wildly disappointing units in the young season.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three units experiencing serious struggles in the young season but first a look at a prolific offense and a devastating defense the season is only a few weeks old but no units have shined brighter than the buffalo bills offense and minnesota vikings defense joe brady and brian flores have unlocked their jimmys and joes by cleverly deploying the x s and o s on the grassy chessboard with both teams sitting atop their respective divisions at 2 0 the rest of the league is trying to figure out how to slow down the bills explosive offense and block the vikings blitz happy defense after digging into the all 22 film on nfl pro here are three keys to tackling two of the league s toughest assignments in 2026 three keys to stopping the bills offense 1 play keep away reducing the number of possessions buffalo receives is the best way to neutralize one of the league s most explosive offenses josh allen and co cannot score if they don t have the ball so a ball control strategy designed to shrink the game is the no 1 objective for a team facing this juggernaut this season the bills are averaging just 28 44 in time of possession 24th in the nfl while running 60 5 offensive plays per game 15th but they lead the league in scoring 38 5 ppg and rank second in total offense 427 5 ypg given the bills explosive potential and efficient production opposing coaches should build game plans around a complementary football strategy that emphasizes a slower offensive pace from taking the play clock down to five seconds or fewer before snapping the ball to staying in bounds on perimeter runs every offensive player must understand the turtle approach being employed to keep buffalo s high powered offense on the sidelines by reducing total possessions and plays opponents can ramp up pressure on the bills offense to do more with less although the ultra efficient unit has set off fireworks with limited possessions thus far the slowdown strategy gives opponents a better chance to win with stops and turnovers which are at a higher premium in a low possession game 2 make josh allen win from the pocket the 2024 nfl mvp is one of the league s most dangerous playmakers having eclipsed 35 total touchdowns for six straight seasons in each of the past three campaigns the 6 foot 5 237 pounder has logged at least 25 passing tds and 12 rushing scores a feat no other quarterback has ever accomplished although he is an explosive pocket passer with exceptional range allen is an unstoppable force when he uses his athleticism and running skills to create big plays on the perimeter whether picking up first downs on designed quarterback runs or impromptu scrambles run around tosses the four time pro bowler terrorizes defenses when he flees the pocket to counter his big play potential defensive coordinators must implement a pass rush plan that has everyone rush to the depth of his drop in order to restrict escape lanes in the pocket additionally pass rushers must work together to create a coordinated mush rush as opposed to operating as independent contractors attacking no 17 with random 1 on 1 pass rush maneuvers defensive coordinators also need to account for allen s impact on designed quarterback runs particularly in goal line and short yardage situations the supersized playmaker has a knack for moving the chains and or finding the paint on quarterback powers following direct snaps or flash fakes in the backfield defensive play callers must assign a defender to the quarterback to prevent the bills from capitalizing on the plus one advantage created by a running qb finally the bills signal caller must be kept in check in the gotta have it moments when he is prone to leave the pocket while operating in playmaker mode allen has routinely relied on his improvisational skills on third down in the red zone and in two minute situations so defenders must be aware of his tendencies in those moments to minimize his impact while containing allen is easier said than done the most successful defenses against buffalo have made the superstar a one dimensional threat 3 take away the middle of the field the bills made a blockbuster trade in march to acquire a wr1 in dj moore but the team s dynamic tight end duo of dalton kincaid and dawson knox is the linchpin of the passing game kincaid in particular has emerged as buffalo s top pass catcher with his speed quickness and ball skills posing problems for linebackers and safeties matching up with him the 2023 first rounder leads the team in targets 14 receptions 12 and receiving yards 225 doing most of his damage on short and intermediate routes between the numbers in addition kincaid is a sneaky vertical threat who routinely cruises past defenders on seam routes since 2024 allen has totaled 11 completions for 253 yards and three touchdowns when targeting kincaid on open downfield throws 3 plus yards of target separation and 10 plus air yards per next gen stats given the playmaking tight end s impact opponents must shut down the middle of the field and force allen to find completions elsewhere by jamming the middle with a robber safety or utilizing bracket coverage with a linebacker and safety assigned to kincaid the defense can put the onus on moore and others to win their 1 on 1 matchups on the perimeter despite the fanfare around moore s arrival and his eye popping yards per catch average thus far 20 0 the bills inside out passing game is nearly impossible to stop when their no 1 tight end is getting loose over the middle by limiting kincaid s impact and forcing buffalo to rely on a complementary pass catcher to carry the aerial attack opponents can hope the tactics disrupt a well oiled machine that is already in midseason form three keys to surviving the vikings defense 1 crack the code vikings dc brian flores exotic pressures and unorthodox coverage patterns are masked by a clever series of pre snap disguises that befuddle quarterbacks at the line of scrimmage with the organized chaos creating hesitation and doubt for novice and experienced passers opposing coaching staffs should operate at a quicker pace to give their quarterbacks access to the offensive coordinator at the line of scrimmage communication devices shut off with 15 seconds left on the play clock and allow for double cadence calls qb barks out the signals and fakes a snap count before re assessing the defense and repeating the process with a different play call based on the defensive look those kinds of tactics force the vikings to reveal their plans while plenty of quarterbacks have attempted these techniques against flores aggressive approach the vikings snowflake game plans make it hard to predict how the defense will align after the snap as a zone blitz heavy outfit minnesota s d balances ultra aggressive six man hot pressures with three man rushes drop eight coverages consequently quarterbacks are lured into a high stakes guessing game that ultimately produces mistakes and turnovers against a unit that relies heavily on blitzes and chaos a quicker tempo produces more vanilla defensive looks due to communication and alignment assignment issues with so many tempo ploys available to offensive coordinators the best game plan should mix no huddle sugar huddle and fast break tactics that eliminate the time minnesota needs to run intricate pre snap disguises 2 win early downs with quicks screens and runs if opponents want to avoid the chaotic pressures flores likes to employ on third down they must stay on schedule by gaining 4 plus yards on first down using a mix of quick throws screens and downhill runs to keep minnesota defenders guessing considering minnesota s ridiculous blitz rate thus far this season 75 percent nearly 30 percent more than anyone else the ball has to come out quickly to keep the quarterback upright in the pocket although the vikings utilize vision and break blitz zones with defenders keying the quarterback catch and throw routes are the best way to consistently pick up 5 yard gains whether targeting running backs tight ends or wide receivers on swings quick outs hitches or slants the high percentage throws create a series of 1 on 1 tackling drills that test the defense s prowess in space moreover it gives the offense a chance to produce some chunk plays on easy throws given how challenging it is to tackle early in the season due to limited reps in preseason and training camp it makes sense to test minnesota s defensive backs on the perimeter if a few quick passes turn into big plays after missed tackles the ultra aggressive play caller might have to scale back some of his exotics to settle down his troops beyond the screens and quick game strategies opponents must run the ball at the vikings despite minnesota s heavy use of six man pressures that snuff out many running plays a persistent ground attack keeps the game plan from turning into a one dimensional call sheet more suited to a 7 on 7 passing competition the vikings rank 13th in rush defense with opponents averaging 100 yards per game on the ground although those numbers are solid for a defense that aims to harass quarterbacks and create turnovers it suggests opponents might be able to carve out some room on the ground with early down runs to stay on schedule against a d that wants to create chaos at every turn 3 take your shot flores is unapologetically aggressive following a live by the blitz die by the blitz creed that scares some offensive play callers into submission however the aggressive pressure tactics create plenty of big play opportunities if the protection holds up at the line of scrimmage with that in mind quarterbacks must attack the pressure with scripted deep balls that punish the vikings for leaving their defensive backs on islands whether using max protection out of run heavy sets on second third and short situations or taking a shot on first down opponents must consistently threaten the vikes downfield to keep their defensive backs from squatting on short and intermediate routes moreover the selective deep shots could make flores reconsider some of his choices if his unit surrenders a big play or two early in the contest remember the packers raced out to a lead against the vikings in week 1 by taking a few shots to christian watson tucker kraft and jonnu smith by flipping the script on the vikings and attacking their pressure with long bombs opponents can dictate the terms to the defense and turn minnesota s aggressive approach into a favorable situation three wildly disappointing units can they be fixed while the bills offense and vikings defense have opened the 2026 campaign in style several units have seriously stumbled out of the gates i d like to spotlight three that have been particularly awful

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 2 games: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) carted off vs. Jets
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 2 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 2 sunday arizona cardinals cornerback max melton toe was ruled out of sunday s game against the seahawks atlanta falcons cornerback a j terrell groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the panthers defensive end samson ebukam hamstring also was ruled out baltimore ravens offensive tackle ronnie stanley toe did not return to sunday s loss to the saints carolina panthers safety nick scott abdomen was ruled out of sunday s win over the falcons chicago bears quarterback caleb williams was carted to the locker room after suffering a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of sunday s loss to vikings dallas cowboys cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot did not to return to sunday s game against the commanders green bay packers wide receiver jayden reed exited sunday s win over the jets on a stretcher after he was hit in the head area by a defender in the first quarter he was quickly ruled out with a neck injury coach matt lafleur said after the game that reed has movement in his extremities and will remain in the new jersey area overnight offensive tackle zach bako bewele knee was carted off the field with an air cast placed on his injured leg bako bewele also was ruled out guard aaron banks toe was ruled out in the fourth quarter and defensive tackle anthony campbell ankle did not return indianapolis colts wide receiver alec pierce was carted to the locker room during the first half versus the chiefs and ruled out with a heel injury x rays were negative but pierce who was in a boot and using crutches after the game will undergo further testing on monday per espn cb charvarius ward left sunday night s loss with a groin injury los angeles chargers tight end david njoku knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to the raiders miami dolphins running back jaylen wright stinger and defensive end robert beal hamstring did not return to sunday s loss to san francisco minnesota vikings defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins hip did not return to sunday s win over the bears new england patriots offensive lineman mike onwenu ankle was ruled out in the first half of sunday s win over the steelers espn com reported after the game that initial x rays showed onwenu broke his right ankle tight end eli raridon thigh also was ruled out linebacker dre 39 mont jones shoulder and safety dell pettus ankle did not return new york jets defensive lineman david onyemata groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the packers linebackers marcelino mccrary ball ankle and kiko mauigoa quad also did not return philadelphia eagles tight end dallas goedert knee did not return to sunday s win over the titans running back saquon barkley missed most of the first half after suffering a stinger barkley returned to the field after halftime barkley said after the game that he will undergo an mri pittsburgh steelers running back rico dowdle toe missed part of the first half of sunday s loss to the patriots before returning after halftime san francisco 49ers receiver demarcus robinson ankle was ruled out of sunday s game against the dolphins head coach kyle shanahan told reporters after the game robinson and dt james thompson have high ankle sprains wide receiver mike evans hip did not return to the game but the injury doesn t look serious per shanahan seattle seahawks running back jadarian price chest did not return to sunday s game against the cardinals hc mike macdonald said after the game that x rays came back negative on price s injury washington commanders quarterback jayden daniels dislocated his left elbow in sunday s loss to the cowboys head coach dan quinn said quinn told reporters that an x ray on daniels elbow didn t show a fracture but the qb will undergo more testing daniels was ruled out after getting injured at the end of the first half versus dallas he was seen leaving the stadium with his arm in a sling per local reporters sunday s game between the cleveland browns and tampa bay buccaneers was suspended in the fourth quarter due to lightning in the area the delay lasted over two hours before play resumed at 6 10 p m et
