news_mentions.headline: Packers coach Matt LaFleur: 'Butt-whooping' from Falcons was 'humbling'
news_mentions.description: The Green Bay Packers got bullied by a previously 0-2 Atlanta Falcons squad, 35-14, as the Lambeau Field fans rained down boos.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay is no stranger to dense flurries usually they don t come in september and usually those squalls aren t of the vociferous nature from locals fed up with the football team thursday night packers fans showered their club with boos during an embarrassing 35 14 loss to the atlanta falcons well that was a humbling night coach matt lafleur said certainly i don t think anybody is pleased about this and you know we ve got a couple extra days here and everybody s got to take a long hard look at themselves and we ve got to find solutions and just come back ready to work but it certainly was a tough night tough doesn t begin to describe the ugly watch as the packers gave up 27 unanswered points at one point lafleur s offense couldn t move the ball the defense couldn t stop bijan robinson or drake london green bay made a previously 0 2 falcons squad look like the 89 niners it was a butt whooping lafleur noted i m not going to put it on one thing certainly we definitely have to respond better but that was at least three quarters of butt whooping right there atlanta lost 34 3 at home to the carolina panthers on sunday was the return of michael penix worth a 52 point swing the quarterback certainly got kevin stefanski s offense motoring without the clutch crippling miscues from qb3 and qb4 who played in the first two games thursday s tilt however said much more about the packers than the falcons lafleur s squad is a mismanaged game by jets coach aaron glenn from starting 0 3 green bay has lost two of its first three games by at least 17 points in 2026 it is the first time the packers have lost multiple games by 17 points in an entire season since 2017 their 21 point loss in week 3 versus the falcons is their largest home loss in prime time since week 5 2004 against steve mcnair and the titans lost 48 27 their 35 point differential in 2026 is their worst through three games since 1988 the defense has struggled to get stops on thursday the packers missed a trove of tackles and the back end got burned when they stepped up to try to slow robinson more concerning is an offense playing as if it s in quicksand the shuffled offensive line is a mess it can t pass block or open holes the running game is cripplingly bad with rbs who miss holes rarely break tackles or try to bounce everything outside and jordan love has been an inaccurate disaster whether the pressure has gotten to the qb who entered his fourth year as a starter or he s simply panicking love s play has been dismal through three games love was pressured 23 times 41 8 pressure rate in week 3 against the falcons completing eight of 21 pass attempts for 71 yards and one interception to start the season love has been pressured on 42 1 of his dropbacks completing just 18 passes under pressure for 47 yards and two interceptions the lack of a rushing attack has been a problem it was a surprise during the offseason that green bay didn t do more to bolster the rb room given josh jacobs legal quandary with the veteran on the commissioner s exempt list that problem has been exacerbated the packers rushed for 17 total yards on nine carries on thursday the falcons had three runs of at least 16 yards i think we ve got to continue to work with these guys and try to figure out what we do well because right now i don t know what we re doing well offensively lafleur admitted it was obvious to the home fans who booed the packers play relentlessly tight end tucker kraft who suffered several drops took issue with the green bay fanatics voicing their negative opinion that s pretty tough like everyone pictures lambeau field and not boos kraft said via matt schneidman of the athletic i don t picture boos i picture my home stadium that s tough it s pretty disappointing especially for a home opener it s pretty disappointing it s not going to help us win like i don t know what people think that s going to rally us or something like that but that s we re grown men we re mentally strong enough capable enough to get back on the field and play ball but it d probably much easier with the 70 000 people behind us rather than opposing us the loyalty of packers fans is unquestioned if they re booing it s because the product is not up to the level of excellence the organization has established blind support is for sheep the extra few days before the packers take the field again in tampa bay are as pivotal a stretch as lafleur has faced in his tenure in green bay

news_mentions.headline: Falcons-Packers on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Atlanta's 35-14 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Grant Gordon breaks down the top takeaways from the Atlanta Falcons' 35-14 win over the Green Bay Packers for their first victory of the season.
news_mentions.body_text: bijan shines in prime time again michael penix was back on thursday night but more importantly bijan robinson returned to prime time one of the greatest talents in the nfl has a history of showing out under the lights and he did so again on thursday night football propelling the falcons to their first win of what has been a dismal season entering week 3 atlanta hadn t scored a touchdown since a week 1 first quarter catch by robinson from cooper rush robinson ended that streak with a 3 yard td in the opening quarter thursday which began a scoring surge for the falcons of 27 straight points after his 213 scrimmage yards thursday he s averaging 145 4 scrimmage yards per prime time game which is tops in nfl chronicle minimum five games his last appearance in prime time was in a stunning week 17 upset of the rams last season striding for a 93 yard touchdown amid a 229 scrimmage yard showing on thursday he rushed for 194 yards and two touchdowns on 29 carries while hauling in two passes for 19 yards it was a more pivotal performance than last season though atlanta was off to a disastrous start over two ugly games all is not puppies and rainbows now but when you ve got one of the best players in the game hope is always on the roster that showed in spectacular fashion home not so sweet home despite a rough 1 1 start to the year the packers surely would find solace in their cozy confines of lambeau field against a winless falcons squad right nope for the first time since 2012 the packers lost their home opener snapping an nfl long 13 game winning streak it was an insulting footnote to a rather horrendous evening for green bay all around missing micah parsons knee and josh jacobs commissioner s exempt list and with the offensive line depleted the packers struggles were all too familiar for this still infant season jordan love was under consistent duress and frequently inaccurate the running game was next door to non existent 17 net yards the defense did no favors either allowing a woebegone falcons offense to run and pass wild with robinson and drake london each turning in near 200 yard performances a mini bye lies ahead for the packers giving them some extra time to figure out how to salvage a quickly sinking ship penix settles in during debut on a long road back from an acl tear last season penix made his 2026 debut thursday night he struggled early looking terrible at times frankly as he was skittish in the pocket and worried into myriad bad throws he completed only one of his five pass attempts with an interception over atlanta s first two drives with robinson setting the tone though penix settled in and the offense was better for it particularly london who had a career high 194 yards on nine catches sparked by the sensational play of robinson the falcons truly found their rhythm when penix did he finished with 256 yards on 18 of 25 passing with a 5 yard touchdown pass to austin hooper it was rough early accentuated by penix throwing a bad interception to xavier mckinney on the fourth play of the game it ended very well however penix was the third qb to play for atlanta this season and the second to start perhaps the position is solidified at least for the immediate future no love for jordan up front with starters aaron banks and zach bako bewele out thursday night and bako bewele gone for the year the packers offensive line woes were exasperated thursday love was under siege and inaccurate which has been a problem for three weeks now the problems that have plagued the packers offense all season are clear a porous offensive line a non existent running attack and a quarterback who s been misfiring likely as a byproduct of the issues surrounding him love who entered the game with an nfl worst 52 1 completion percentage among qualified starters was 28 of 53 52 8 for 312 yards just 5 9 yards per attempt with one touchdown and an interception he was only sacked once but atlanta had 12 qb hits and 23 qb pressures 41 8 pressure rate meanwhile marshawn lloyd was the team s leading rusher with 11 yards on four carries in contrast to the green bay defense allowing 242 yards on the ground to atlanta second year wide receiver matthew golden had five catches for 100 yards and a touchdown it was his first td and 100 yard showing of his career both looming large as there was little on thursday night for the packers to look at optimistically for what lies ahead henderson falcons d step up for as lackluster as the packers offense was credit does need to go to the falcons defense cornerback c j henderson the 2020 nfl draft s no 9 overall pick who s now playing for his third team stepped in for an injured a j terrell and played excellent ball for the most part the packers targeted him 12 times but he came up with three passes defensed and allowed five catches for 52 yards jalon walker s gone for the season due to injury and james pearce continues to serve his suspension but cameron thomas six qb pressures sack and co made life difficult all night for the opposition jeff ulbrich s defense allowed just 328 yards to the packers at lambeau field that s a heckuva first win and a defensive performance to build on next gen stats insight for falcons packers via nfl pro bijan robinson s 55 yard run in the first quarter the longest of the season so far in the nfl saw him run a total distance of 89 6 yards nfl research kevin stefanski earned his first win with the falcons and it came with michael penix s first start of the year penix is the 15th quarterback to start a game for stefanski and the 11th to win a game for the former browns coach in 104 career games

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Michael Baca provides a refresher on the Atlanta Falcons' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the atlanta falcons offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookie veterans location ibm performance field flowery branch georgia fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs detroit lions 7 p m et on friday aug 8 week 2 vs tennessee titans 7 p m et nfl network on friday aug 15 week 3 at dallas cowboys 8 p m et nfl network on friday aug 22 2025 schedule note for the second consecutive season the falcons will open the campaign with four of their first five games against teams that made the playoffs the year before nfl research what you need to know 1 following a dramatic and underwhelming season at quarterback which saw kirk cousins lose his job to michael penix the falcons will put their best foot forward in order to achieve harmony under center penix this season s unquestioned starting qb looks to finely tune his role after showing flashes along his three starts as a rookie entering his second training camp the strong armed lefty now has ample time to establish a rapport with a pass catching corps that remains largely unchanged and to grow into his role as the offense s leading voice over the summer cousins meanwhile appears to have accepted his fate as a backup at this juncture making for what could be a peculiar scene if the high priced qb sees plenty of action in the preseason moreover if cousins 36 looks improved another year removed from a torn achilles could other teams reignite a trade discussion 2 atlanta s mission to improve its pass rush continued with a splashy first round in april s draft selecting jalon walker at no 15 overall before trading back into round 1 to take james pearce 10 picks later walker a product of georgia and last year s butkus award winner was seen as one of top pass rushing prospects but pearce s selection one achieved by trading away next year s first round pick was one of the more surprising developments of the 2025 nfl draft walker and pearce s progression throughout training camp and in the preseason ought to be keenly observed considering the heavy investment the falcons who hired jeff ulbrich as their new defensive coordinator also signed leonard floyd this offseason as part of revamping a pass rush that finished 31st in the league in sacks 31 last season 3 training camp and preseason is where kicking competitions thrive and there s a compelling one brewing in atlanta following younghoe koo s down season the falcons signed german born kicker lenny krieg to a three year deal that includes a signing bonus and a base salary guarantee that kind of contract doesn t come often in the international market but it came after krieg impressed at the international player pathway program s pro day koo who s held the job the past six seasons generated a career low 73 5 field goal percentage and his struggles cost the falcons a game down the stretch with three missed kicks in a three point loss koo and krieg s battle over the next two months could provide the scintillating moments we look for as we prepare for the oncoming season

news_mentions.headline: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? Plus, three disappointing units
news_mentions.description: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks provides game plans for two of the NFL's toughest assignments. Plus, three wildly disappointing units in the young season.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three units experiencing serious struggles in the young season but first a look at a prolific offense and a devastating defense the season is only a few weeks old but no units have shined brighter than the buffalo bills offense and minnesota vikings defense joe brady and brian flores have unlocked their jimmys and joes by cleverly deploying the x s and o s on the grassy chessboard with both teams sitting atop their respective divisions at 2 0 the rest of the league is trying to figure out how to slow down the bills explosive offense and block the vikings blitz happy defense after digging into the all 22 film on nfl pro here are three keys to tackling two of the league s toughest assignments in 2026 three keys to stopping the bills offense 1 play keep away reducing the number of possessions buffalo receives is the best way to neutralize one of the league s most explosive offenses josh allen and co cannot score if they don t have the ball so a ball control strategy designed to shrink the game is the no 1 objective for a team facing this juggernaut this season the bills are averaging just 28 44 in time of possession 24th in the nfl while running 60 5 offensive plays per game 15th but they lead the league in scoring 38 5 ppg and rank second in total offense 427 5 ypg given the bills explosive potential and efficient production opposing coaches should build game plans around a complementary football strategy that emphasizes a slower offensive pace from taking the play clock down to five seconds or fewer before snapping the ball to staying in bounds on perimeter runs every offensive player must understand the turtle approach being employed to keep buffalo s high powered offense on the sidelines by reducing total possessions and plays opponents can ramp up pressure on the bills offense to do more with less although the ultra efficient unit has set off fireworks with limited possessions thus far the slowdown strategy gives opponents a better chance to win with stops and turnovers which are at a higher premium in a low possession game 2 make josh allen win from the pocket the 2024 nfl mvp is one of the league s most dangerous playmakers having eclipsed 35 total touchdowns for six straight seasons in each of the past three campaigns the 6 foot 5 237 pounder has logged at least 25 passing tds and 12 rushing scores a feat no other quarterback has ever accomplished although he is an explosive pocket passer with exceptional range allen is an unstoppable force when he uses his athleticism and running skills to create big plays on the perimeter whether picking up first downs on designed quarterback runs or impromptu scrambles run around tosses the four time pro bowler terrorizes defenses when he flees the pocket to counter his big play potential defensive coordinators must implement a pass rush plan that has everyone rush to the depth of his drop in order to restrict escape lanes in the pocket additionally pass rushers must work together to create a coordinated mush rush as opposed to operating as independent contractors attacking no 17 with random 1 on 1 pass rush maneuvers defensive coordinators also need to account for allen s impact on designed quarterback runs particularly in goal line and short yardage situations the supersized playmaker has a knack for moving the chains and or finding the paint on quarterback powers following direct snaps or flash fakes in the backfield defensive play callers must assign a defender to the quarterback to prevent the bills from capitalizing on the plus one advantage created by a running qb finally the bills signal caller must be kept in check in the gotta have it moments when he is prone to leave the pocket while operating in playmaker mode allen has routinely relied on his improvisational skills on third down in the red zone and in two minute situations so defenders must be aware of his tendencies in those moments to minimize his impact while containing allen is easier said than done the most successful defenses against buffalo have made the superstar a one dimensional threat 3 take away the middle of the field the bills made a blockbuster trade in march to acquire a wr1 in dj moore but the team s dynamic tight end duo of dalton kincaid and dawson knox is the linchpin of the passing game kincaid in particular has emerged as buffalo s top pass catcher with his speed quickness and ball skills posing problems for linebackers and safeties matching up with him the 2023 first rounder leads the team in targets 14 receptions 12 and receiving yards 225 doing most of his damage on short and intermediate routes between the numbers in addition kincaid is a sneaky vertical threat who routinely cruises past defenders on seam routes since 2024 allen has totaled 11 completions for 253 yards and three touchdowns when targeting kincaid on open downfield throws 3 plus yards of target separation and 10 plus air yards per next gen stats given the playmaking tight end s impact opponents must shut down the middle of the field and force allen to find completions elsewhere by jamming the middle with a robber safety or utilizing bracket coverage with a linebacker and safety assigned to kincaid the defense can put the onus on moore and others to win their 1 on 1 matchups on the perimeter despite the fanfare around moore s arrival and his eye popping yards per catch average thus far 20 0 the bills inside out passing game is nearly impossible to stop when their no 1 tight end is getting loose over the middle by limiting kincaid s impact and forcing buffalo to rely on a complementary pass catcher to carry the aerial attack opponents can hope the tactics disrupt a well oiled machine that is already in midseason form three keys to surviving the vikings defense 1 crack the code vikings dc brian flores exotic pressures and unorthodox coverage patterns are masked by a clever series of pre snap disguises that befuddle quarterbacks at the line of scrimmage with the organized chaos creating hesitation and doubt for novice and experienced passers opposing coaching staffs should operate at a quicker pace to give their quarterbacks access to the offensive coordinator at the line of scrimmage communication devices shut off with 15 seconds left on the play clock and allow for double cadence calls qb barks out the signals and fakes a snap count before re assessing the defense and repeating the process with a different play call based on the defensive look those kinds of tactics force the vikings to reveal their plans while plenty of quarterbacks have attempted these techniques against flores aggressive approach the vikings snowflake game plans make it hard to predict how the defense will align after the snap as a zone blitz heavy outfit minnesota s d balances ultra aggressive six man hot pressures with three man rushes drop eight coverages consequently quarterbacks are lured into a high stakes guessing game that ultimately produces mistakes and turnovers against a unit that relies heavily on blitzes and chaos a quicker tempo produces more vanilla defensive looks due to communication and alignment assignment issues with so many tempo ploys available to offensive coordinators the best game plan should mix no huddle sugar huddle and fast break tactics that eliminate the time minnesota needs to run intricate pre snap disguises 2 win early downs with quicks screens and runs if opponents want to avoid the chaotic pressures flores likes to employ on third down they must stay on schedule by gaining 4 plus yards on first down using a mix of quick throws screens and downhill runs to keep minnesota defenders guessing considering minnesota s ridiculous blitz rate thus far this season 75 percent nearly 30 percent more than anyone else the ball has to come out quickly to keep the quarterback upright in the pocket although the vikings utilize vision and break blitz zones with defenders keying the quarterback catch and throw routes are the best way to consistently pick up 5 yard gains whether targeting running backs tight ends or wide receivers on swings quick outs hitches or slants the high percentage throws create a series of 1 on 1 tackling drills that test the defense s prowess in space moreover it gives the offense a chance to produce some chunk plays on easy throws given how challenging it is to tackle early in the season due to limited reps in preseason and training camp it makes sense to test minnesota s defensive backs on the perimeter if a few quick passes turn into big plays after missed tackles the ultra aggressive play caller might have to scale back some of his exotics to settle down his troops beyond the screens and quick game strategies opponents must run the ball at the vikings despite minnesota s heavy use of six man pressures that snuff out many running plays a persistent ground attack keeps the game plan from turning into a one dimensional call sheet more suited to a 7 on 7 passing competition the vikings rank 13th in rush defense with opponents averaging 100 yards per game on the ground although those numbers are solid for a defense that aims to harass quarterbacks and create turnovers it suggests opponents might be able to carve out some room on the ground with early down runs to stay on schedule against a d that wants to create chaos at every turn 3 take your shot flores is unapologetically aggressive following a live by the blitz die by the blitz creed that scares some offensive play callers into submission however the aggressive pressure tactics create plenty of big play opportunities if the protection holds up at the line of scrimmage with that in mind quarterbacks must attack the pressure with scripted deep balls that punish the vikings for leaving their defensive backs on islands whether using max protection out of run heavy sets on second third and short situations or taking a shot on first down opponents must consistently threaten the vikes downfield to keep their defensive backs from squatting on short and intermediate routes moreover the selective deep shots could make flores reconsider some of his choices if his unit surrenders a big play or two early in the contest remember the packers raced out to a lead against the vikings in week 1 by taking a few shots to christian watson tucker kraft and jonnu smith by flipping the script on the vikings and attacking their pressure with long bombs opponents can dictate the terms to the defense and turn minnesota s aggressive approach into a favorable situation three wildly disappointing units can they be fixed while the bills offense and vikings defense have opened the 2026 campaign in style several units have seriously stumbled out of the gates i d like to spotlight three that have been particularly awful

news_mentions.headline: Week 3 fantasy sleepers: Jets QB Geno Smith, Eagles WR Dontayvion Wicks offer upside
news_mentions.description: Will Geno Smith rack up big numbers against the Lions? Which Eagles receiver could be a sneaky-good play? Raza Umerani highlights 10 sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 3.
news_mentions.body_text: there s no way to sugarcoat it injuries have sucked a lot of air out of the balloon that is the young season that s not just from a fantasy perspective every football fan wants to watch caleb williams jayden daniels brock bowers and puka nacua on sundays the sport is better when those guys are playing but in fantasy we strategically picked guys like nico collins saquon barkley and dj moore to help us win our leagues now we have to hear the friend who autodrafted boast about being 2 0 not ideal this makes finding sneaky values that much more important not every addition has to be a league winner my goal right now is to get you those week winning stopgaps while your stars are on the mend with that being said welcome to the infirmary of week 3 note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses
