news_mentions.headline: Broncos rookie RB Jonah Coleman heading to IR with ankle injury
news_mentions.body_text: the denver broncos are placing rookie running back jonah coleman on short term injured reserve as he manages an ankle sprain the team announced saturday in a series of roster moves coleman a fourth round pick out of the university of washington had already been ruled out of sunday night 39 s game against the visiting los angeles rams after missing all three practices this week coleman must sit out at least three additional games as he will not be eligible to return until denver 39 s week 7 game at the arizona cardinals coleman suffered the ankle injury during denver 39 s week 2 victory against the jacksonville jaguars he stayed in the game and made a strong contribution in the fourth quarter as the broncos rallied from a 10 point deficit to notch their first win of the season 20 13 coleman scored the go ahead touchdown his first in the nfl on a 3 yard run midway through the final period he then rushed six times for 33 yards on denver 39 s final drive which chewed up the clock and ended with the team kneeling in victory formation coleman the only broncos rookie to play so far this season was needed late against the jaguars because second year back rj harvey was out with a hamstring injury and starter j k dobbins left with a hip injury late in the third quarter coleman finished the game with 58 yards on 13 carries he showed veteran savvy on his final carry when after picking up a first down he slid to the ground inbounds allowing denver to run out the clock harvey and dobbins fully participated in practice thursday and friday and have been cleared to play against the rams veteran tyler badie also figures to be in the backfield rotation sunday after he accounted for 113 all purpose yards in week 2 going forward the broncos could also turn to cody schrader who is in his second season on the team 39 s practice squad and was a standout for denver in the preseason to replace coleman on the active roster the broncos are promoting long snapper mitch fraboni from the practice squad according to the league 39 s transaction wire fullback adam prentice and wide receiver returner kolbe katsis are being elevated from the practice squad for sunday 39 s game this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley says he will play on MNF vs. Bears after last week's stinger
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia saquon barkley will play monday after suffering a stinger during the first offensive play of the philadelphia eagles 39 week 2 win the star running back said friday the eagles visit the chicago bears on 34 monday night football 34 in week 3 barkley was a limited participant in practice thursday before returning to his full workload friday 34 everyone knows what it is a stinger some are worse than others and just keeping the nerves calmed down around it 34 barkley said 34 beautiful thing is it 39 s a monday night game so i have a little more time but right now the mindset is i 39 m good to go might have to put on a little cowboy collar for a little bit but i 39 d rather that than something with my ankles and my feet and my legs 34 barkley exited the game against the tennessee titans last week after taking a hit from defensive lineman jeffery simmons on the opening carry he missed the rest of the first half before returning in the second half wearing the horseshoe shaped neck roll barkley had just five touches in the game he said the padding he wore sunday was restrictive and he 39 s worked with the equipment staff this week on 34 coming up with something that not only is going to protect me but also allows me to play the way i want to play play free 34 barkley said he does not believe the injury will affect him against the bears 34 i know that they wouldn 39 t let me go out there if i wasn 39 t able to do it 34 he said 34 i 39 m gonna go out there and play fearless don 39 t worry about it 133 i 39 ve dealt with a lot of injuries in my career the mental side of it a little bit so i 39 m excited feel good feel like i 39 m having great practice feel like we put a great week of work in as a whole and we got a great opportunity 34 barkley underwent an mri exam earlier this week to ensure the injury was not serious he has a history of stingers this was 34 the first bad one i had in a long time 34 he said a stinger is a nerve injury that causes a stinging pain from the neck down the arm to the hand barkley was seen flexing his left fist on the sideline sunday when asked if the injury could affect his grip or ability to catch the ball barkley said he mostly carries the ball with his right hand so that was not a concern the necessary strength returned this week 34 nerve things are scary 34 barkley said 34 it 39 s not the first stinger i ever got won 39 t be the last but some are worse than others and most important thing our trainers do a really good job of protecting sometimes the trainers gotta protect you from yourself and i think they did that because the second i had any strength back i was ready to go back out there but i had to wait until my strength fully came back but my strength is back we 39 re calming the nerve now and i 39 m blessed 34 barkley has not missed a game due to injury since signing with the eagles in 2024 and he devotes significant time and resources to his body and career longevity he admitted he nbsp 34 probably wasn 39 t as great as i needed to be with my neck stability and strength in my neck 34 barkley 39 s backups are tank bigsby and will shipley both have also been on the injury report this week the eagles rank no 24 in the nfl in epa rush no 14 in rushing yards per game and no 16 in yards per carry barkley stopped himself when he was about to say the eagles must 34 get this thing going 34 because they 39 re 2 0 he acknowledged that the running game can improve a healthy barkley will help 34 just continue to focus on our process and the results will come 34 barkley said 34 i wish i could tell you that they were going to come in week 1 i wish i could guarantee it 39 s going to come in week 3 you just never know but i know that the results will come and we will get this thing rolling it 39 s going to be something scary 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Zach Ertz silences the 'what-if' with Eagles return. Can he play Monday?
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia 34 obviously some things have changed around here 34 zach ertz said the tight end took in the locker room 34 a little bigger 34 he said he 39 d walked through the training room 34 a little better 34 he said he stood there smiling about a homecoming with the philadelphia eagles which he said was long overdue he stood there shifting his weight onto the right knee that made any return to football doubtful ertz tore the acl and lcl in that knee on dec 7 it was a violent injury it was an emotional injury it arrived near the end of his final one year contract with the washington commanders ertz 35 did not know if he would ever play again but he credited his wife julie and their three young boys with motivating his comeback he wanted to set an example for his sons to look back on when they face their own adversities 34 i was gonna do everything i could to get back and i could live with those results 34 ertz said 34 but if i couldn 39 t then i would know i 39 d be at peace but i couldn 39 t live with the fact that i just gave up and there was a 39 what if 39 hanging over my life for the rest of my life 34 now ertz 39 s name is hanging over a green laden locker he stood beneath it waxing nostalgic about 34 a place i 39 ve always called home 34 the eagles picked him no 35 in 2013 one round after right tackle lane johnson ertz got emotional seeing johnson again and owner jeffrey lurie and general manager howie roseman and facility staffers and even first time offensive coordinator sean mannion whom ertz had played against while growing up in california 39 s east bay 34 i beat him in high school 34 ertz said 34 just so we 39 re throwing that out there 34 just don 39 t say this reunion went all according to plan 34 i mean there was never a plan to come back obviously i never wanted to leave in the first place 34 said ertz whom the eagles traded in 2021 amid disagreements over a contract extension 34 the opportunity finally arose that i could come back there 39 s been times i 39 ve asked in the past and it didn 39 t come to fruition for whatever reason but for me it 39 s just a blessing to be back if you told me when i got hurt that i 39 d be back here in nine and a half months practicing for the philadelphia eagles you could have signed me up then 34 ertz 39 s homecoming is a heartening storyline it could culminate in ertz surpassing harold carmichael 39 s franchise record for career receptions he needs 11 catches though ertz said it 34 couldn 39 t be further from the truth 34 that he returned to chase the record practical matters are more pressing an in season problem prompted the eagles to bring ertz back starting tight end dallas goedert sprained his mcl against the tennessee titans and his weekslong recovery timeline effectively launched the break glass scenario for a precarious position group the franchise tried to strengthen in the offseason ertz 39 s own recovery remains an obstacle ertz said his right knee 34 feels great 34 but he acknowledged that he still needs to get it game ready after nearly 10 months away from the field it raises questions about how much ertz can contribute monday night against the chicago bears if the eagles promote him from the practice squad at all ertz must also learn a playbook he said is 34 all new to me 34 ertz acknowledged that he has never really played in an offense centered on the wide zone run game he said he 39 s spent the last few days 34 trying to do a crash course on this offense 34 which included poring over the team 39 s training camp playbooks he said there were maybe 34 two or three pass plays 34 left over from when coach nick sirianni installed his first ever playbook in 2021 sirianni said earlier thursday that the route concepts resemble those in other offenses ertz agreed the language of the plays is new which sirianni likened to someone learning french after speaking english on wednesday mannion gave ertz a vote of confidence saying his 14 year career reflects 34 a really strong record 34 as a 34 very very comfortable pass catcher 34 and a comfortable pass catcher is exactly what the eagles knew they might need managing injuries at tight end is not a new subject for them they arranged consecutive one year contracts for goedert partly due to the 31 year old 39 s injury history but they built their new offensive system around a clear need at tight end with goedert as the position group 39 s only proven pass catcher the other tight ends the eagles carried into the regular season have never totaled more than 20 catches in a season johnny mundt a 10 year veteran was a free agent upgrade for their blocking needs e j jenkins a 2023 practice squad pickup has been targeted once in his 132 career offensive snaps mannion said wednesday that despite what mundt 39 s and jenkins 39 statistical catalogs may say the eagles set being 34 a two way player 34 as a prerequisite for playing tight end in this system and that 34 we feel good about the group 34 roseman raved about jenkins 39 inclusion on the initial 53 man roster in august roseman underlined how jenkins was a former wide receiver at georgia tech who weighed 225 pounds in his final game jenkins is 6 foot 6 and 260 pounds after two years with the eagles roseman called jenkins an effective run blocker at the point of attack in their wide zone concepts and in pass protection but also noted his history as a wide receiver calling him 34 a big target in the passing game 34 34 i mean i know it hasn 39 t been put on display yet but it 39 s always going to be there 34 jenkins said 34 it 39 s not just going to disappear 34 second round pick eli stowers offers little short term insurance the 2025 mackey award winner for the nation 39 s top tight end offers undeniable upside as a pass catcher but the eagles saw stowers 39 lean frame and lack of blocking as a development project to meet the two way prerequisite their system requires stowers is now sidelined and so is depth tight end grant calcaterra who went on injured reserve aug 30 with a back injury the eagles placed stowers on ir with hamstring and quadriceps injuries the day before the regular season opener he must miss at least four games but his tepid progress before the injury casts doubt on how much he can contribute in 2026 roseman emphasized a 34 long term view 34 when discussing stowers at the end of training camp the eagles are still acting on that view they placed ertz in a locker next to stowers supplying young talent with veteran mentors is an organizational staple 34 i don 39 t think it 39 s an accident that they put me here 34 ertz said 34 everyone 39 s got a superpower in this league 34 ertz said of stowers 34 and he 39 s got to play to his superpower and i 39 m looking forward to helping him kind of unlock that mentally physically to be at his best 34 ertz was the eagles 39 most available option in their contingency plan ertz made his interest in a return to philly known throughout the offseason the eagles appeared cautious on the same day roseman addressed stowers 39 status with reporters he acknowledged that he 39 d spoken with ertz 34 over a period of time 34 to maintain their relationship and understand where ertz was in his recovery he balanced praise for ertz by calling him 34 one of the greatest tight ends to play the game 34 with a note that he was 34 excited about the tight ends that we have here 34 the tact behind roseman 39 s words reflected the politics at play in 2021 ertz was then at the same stage in his career as goedert is now ertz secured the contract he 39 d coveted in arizona five years later with ertz wanting to return to philly and the eagles wanting proven depth a reunion made sense 34 everything 39 s discussed everything has a plan 34 sirianni said 34 that 39 s what i appreciate so much about howie everything 39 s thought out everything 39 s got a plan and here we are today in the situation we 39 re in and zach being here i 39 m excited about that opportunity for him 34 the eagles have friday and saturday practices before they must make a decision about ertz if they aim to dress three tight ends against the bears their only other option right now is promoting josiah deguara from the practice squad deguara a seventh year veteran played in 12 games for the cardinals in 2025 in a blocking oriented role but ertz underlined that he isn 39 t yet even on the active roster it 39 s up to the coaches to decide whether his play in practice merits a return on monday night 34 it 39 s about going out there and proving that i can make a difference in the game 34 ertz said 34 if i can 39 t make a difference in the game then i shouldn 39 t be out there 34 this article news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Grodon provides a refresher on the Los Angeles Rams' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the los angeles rams offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookies and veterans location loyola marymount university los angeles california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs dallas cowboys 7 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 vs los angeles chargers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 at cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note los angeles plays the 2024 season s worst team the titans who had the no 1 pick in the 2025 draft in week 2 and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took the eventual super bowl champion philadelphia eagles to the limit in the divisional round the rams are heading into 2025 with high hopes the addition of davante adams has only stoked expectations for a matthew stafford led offense a closer look offers a reminder that the rams offense was just 26th in total yards and middle of the road in points scored 17th just how quickly adams assimilates into sean mcvay s offense and develops chemistry with stafford and rams wr1 puka nacua will be a key to camp and l a returning its offense to a high octane force on a consistent basis 2 les snead and the rams have stacked up some stellar drafts they have piled up standout starters such as running back kyren williams 2022 fifth round defensive lineman kobie turner 2023 second wide receiver puka nacua 2023 fifth defensive lineman jared verse 2024 first dl braden fiske 2024 second and far too many more to list here in 2025 there s a lack of ballyhoo accompanying the latest class but with the rams recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 3: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 3 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 24 los angeles chargers 16 cleveland browns 21 carolina panthers 18 detroit lions 31 new york jets 24 indianapolis colts 19 houston texans 17 jacksonville jaguars 35 new england patriots 6 kansas city chiefs 24 miami dolphins 10 new york giants 12 tennessee titans 7 pittsburgh steelers 30 cincinnati bengals 27 washington commanders 33 seattle seahawks 31 late window arizona cardinals at san francisco 49ers minnesota vikings at tampa bay buccaneers las vegas raiders at new orleans saints baltimore ravens at dallas cowboys sunday night los angeles rams at denver broncos nick shook s analysis to come back to top nick shook s analysis to come back to top kevin patra s takeaways gibbs lions offense powers win over jets jahmyr gibbs did his best barry sanders impression carrying detroit to a win with jukes galore the stud running back scored three second half touchdowns starting with a 17 yard against the grain jaunt in which no 0 pulled off a no 20 imitation gibbs was a mismatch against the jets older linebackers in the passing attack repeatedly finding space in the open field he finished with 99 rushing yards and two scores on 20 carries plus seven catches for 65 yards and the game winning td gibbs ability to gash defenses on the outside while also muscling for short yardage games shows complete back ability his talent as a pass catcher makes him unstoppable powered by gibbs the lions offense moved up and down the field for the final three quarters scoring on five of six drives they avoided a three and out all day while putting up 30 plus points for the third time in three weeks to open the season jets battle but come up short geno smith and the offense needed time to kick things into gear after going three and out in two of the first three drives smith diced up the lions secondary displaying good pocket acumen and a willingness to sit in and take a hit smith threw for 321 yards on 31 of 37 with three tds the jets took advantage of their tight end matchups rookie kenyon sadiq had the best game of his young career proving to be a good outlet with good hands and the ability to dust lbs he finished with 105 yards and his first career receiving td on seven catches sacks stymied the jets offense early but the offensive line cleaned things up in the second half allowing the jets to tie the game late after falling behind 14 0 then the lions threw a big blitz and chuck clark got away clean and sacked smith who fumbled with a chance to score late once again the jets showed they can compete the next step is turning close losses into actual wins lions d makes a late play after struggling to slow the jets kelvin sheppard dialed up a blitz that confused the jets blocking and allowed clark to come up with the game sealing strip it s a good thing chuck clark made the play because detroit s defense once again showed an inability to get a stop in the second half with defensive backs getting burned so often the pass rush rarely gets a chance to get to the quarterback when the defensive line is blocked up it s almost assuredly a big play for the opponent former jet d j reed continues to struggle getting picked on and racking up defensive interference calls reed versus garrett wilson was a clear mismatch when a team s most veteran cb is a liability it s going to be a problem at this stage the defense s hope is to get just enough stops while the offense keeps racking up points it s a defense that requires a near perfect offense to rack up ws next gen stats insight for lions jets via nfl pro the jets blitzed jared goff on 44 4 of his dropbacks with goff completing all 14 of his attempts for 148 yards and a touchdown when facing extra rushers 27 8 cpoe goff also fared well on play action completing 11 of 13 attempts for 181 yards nfl research with his two rushing touchdowns in week 3 jahmyr gibbs 43 passed billy sims 42 for the second most rushing touchdowns in lions franchise history trailing only hall of famer barry sanders 99 gibbs also recorded his fifth career game with three touchdowns tying hof jim brown and todd gurley for the most three plus td games by a player before turning 25 in nfl history his seven career games with 150 plus scrimmage yards and multiple scrimmage touchdowns trail only hall of famers jim brown 11 barry sanders nine and walter payton eight for most by a player under the age of 25 in nfl history back to top bobby kownack s analysis to come back to top dan parr s takeaways jaguars dominated jacksonville never trailed on sunday and it didn t relent when new england s miscues piled up it seems a healthy sign for the jags that they didn t simply survive against the sloppy patriots they buried the reigning afc champions the offense bounced back after disappearing in the second half against the broncos last week with trevor lawrence throwing touchdown passes to three different players lawrence now has 105 career passing tds surpassing blake bortles for second in franchise history it was particularly encouraging to see the offensive line perform much better than it did against denver the pats were down some starters on defense and lawrence did throw an interception for the second week in a row but jacksonville had put the game out of reach by the third quarter liam coen has a legitimate chance to be the first head coach to lead the jaguars to consecutive playoff appearances in the current millennium nightmarish day for maye the vibes around drake maye have not been lower since he was drafted third overall in 2024 he threw two interceptions including one in the end zone that killed a patriots drive also he lost a fumble when the ball slipped out of his hand as he reached back to pass in the first quarter the jaguars scored a td on the ensuing possession and new england never recovered suffering its most lopsided loss since mike vrabel was hired as head coach prior to the 2025 season in a sign of just how bad things were on sunday vrabel sat maye for the second half of the fourth quarter inserting backup tommy devito at quarterback with the game out of reach a j brown ankle is still weeks away from returning and a trip to face the division leading bills awaits so things are not about to get easier for vrabel s squad hunter is on the board travis hunter the second overall pick of the 2025 nfl draft finally has his first career interception picking off drake maye in the second quarter on a pass to the end zone intended for efton chism it s been a bumpy ride for hunter in the nfl due in large part to the injury that ended his rookie year in week 7 and the team s struggle to maximize his ability as a two way player he played a season high 42 snaps on defense in week 3 and perhaps sunday s int will be a new beginning of sorts for the franchise s massive investment next gen stats insight for patriots jaguars via nfl pro the jaguars generated pressure on 58 4 of drake maye s dropbacks the third highest pressure rate he has faced in the regular season against pressure maye went 6 of 11 for 81 yards and an interception without pressure he went 8 of 14 for 118 yards and an interception nfl research drake maye s seven turnovers are the most by a patriots player in the team s first three games of a season over the last 30 years back to top bobby kownack s takeaways chiefs score ho hum win although kansas city hardly felt in danger of losing this was more of a slow developing victory for the chiefs than their fans probably would ve liked patrick mahomes found completions pretty much wherever he wanted going 20 of 24 for 246 yards two touchdowns and a tipped interception but it didn t result in opening up a sizeable lead until late the pick was partly to blame for that as was a turnover on downs at midfield during the drive preceding it and while it s difficult to harp on flaws after a defense forced two turnovers and only allowed 10 points the group s performance didn t feel dominant in a way that the week 1 victory over the broncos was the chiefs let the dolphins hang around until late allowing numerous extended drives even if several ultimately proved fruitless mansoor delane did look good coming off his shoulder injury he had 10 tackles and a pass deflection while allowing just 24 yards on nine targets nick bolton was also all over the place with a game high 11 tackles and chris jones tipped a malik willis pass in the air for a george karlaftis interception to end any hopes of a miami comeback perhaps wanting more after a double digit win is a sign the super bowl contending chiefs are back though fins hang tough on both sides the final score does not indicate just how hard the dolphins fought to stay in the game until the very end kansas city didn t pull ahead by more than one possession until just under three minutes remained although the dolphins offense scored under 14 points for a third straight week the unit represented itself well while undermanned due to injuries the team s leading receiver caleb douglas missed sunday s action due to an ankle injury and running back de 39 von achane injured his knee on miami s first drive but miami nonetheless was able to sustain a handful of lengthy marches on the same possession achane went down the dolphins went 91 yards on 17 plays for a touchdown miami s first three possessions in the second half also took at least nine plays even if it didn t result in a win the dolphins ability to play keep away from patrick mahomes winning the time of possession by nearly nine minutes and ending with just 5 fewer total net yards than the chiefs was admirable malik willis was a bit more open to rushing than the previous two weeks with 56 yards on nine carries which helped keep kansas city off balance the qb also got chris bell as involved as he s been yet hitting the rookie four times for a team leading 67 yards defensively the dolphins buckled down after looking anemic allowing two straight td drives to open the game they didn t allow another point from kansas city until the fourth quarter keeping the score in reach with a forced turnover on downs and jacob rodriguez first career interception it s still a loss for the 0 3 dolphins but the process looked promising for a rebuilding squad kwiii continues to deliver it wasn t as electric as his two 100 yard rushing games to kick off his chiefs tenure but kenneth walker was again the sparkplug for kansas city s offense against the dolphins he scored the team s first two touchdowns a 10 yard run up the gut of miami s defense and a 5 yard reception on an underhand toss from patrick mahomes walker did surprisingly get stuffed on a fourth down in the second quarter and was held to a season low 3 9 yards per carry but a lot of credit belongs to miami s penetration he was still making plenty of his opportunities with three runs of 10 plus yards and 16 rushing yards over expected as he finished with 70 yards on 18 attempts that brings the tough running walker to 360 rushing yards already on the season with another 82 receiving he has completely changed the complexion of the chiefs offense in just three short games next gen stats insight for chiefs dolphins via nfl pro kenneth walker forced 12 missed tackles in the running game against the dolphins the third time that walker forced 12 or more missed tackles on carries in a game this season nfl research patrick mahomes picked up his 98th career win breaking a tie with tom brady for the third most quarterback wins in a player s first 10 seasons since quarterback starts were tracked in 1950 the only quarterbacks with more than mahomes are peyton manning 105 and russell wilson 104 with mahomes still having 14 games remaining in his 10th season back to top jeremy bergman s analysis to come back to top brooke cersosimo s analysis to come back to top kevin patra s analysis to come back to top brooke cersosimo s analysis to come back to top kevin patra s analysis news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: Minnesota Vikings training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Minnesota Vikings' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again
