story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 2 games: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) carted off vs. Jets
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 2 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 2 sunday arizona cardinals cornerback max melton toe was ruled out of sunday s game against the seahawks atlanta falcons cornerback a j terrell groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the panthers defensive end samson ebukam hamstring also was ruled out baltimore ravens offensive tackle ronnie stanley toe did not return to sunday s loss to the saints carolina panthers safety nick scott abdomen was ruled out of sunday s win over the falcons chicago bears quarterback caleb williams was carted to the locker room after suffering a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of sunday s loss to vikings dallas cowboys cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot did not to return to sunday s game against the commanders green bay packers wide receiver jayden reed exited sunday s win over the jets on a stretcher after he was hit in the head area by a defender in the first quarter he was quickly ruled out with a neck injury coach matt lafleur said after the game that reed has movement in his extremities and will remain in the new jersey area overnight offensive tackle zach bako bewele knee was carted off the field with an air cast placed on his injured leg bako bewele also was ruled out guard aaron banks toe was ruled out in the fourth quarter and defensive tackle anthony campbell ankle did not return indianapolis colts wide receiver alec pierce was carted to the locker room during the first half versus the chiefs and ruled out with a heel injury x rays were negative but pierce who was in a boot and using crutches after the game will undergo further testing on monday per espn cb charvarius ward left sunday night s loss with a groin injury los angeles chargers tight end david njoku knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to the raiders miami dolphins running back jaylen wright stinger and defensive end robert beal hamstring did not return to sunday s loss to san francisco minnesota vikings defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins hip did not return to sunday s win over the bears new england patriots offensive lineman mike onwenu ankle was ruled out in the first half of sunday s win over the steelers espn com reported after the game that initial x rays showed onwenu broke his right ankle tight end eli raridon thigh also was ruled out linebacker dre 39 mont jones shoulder and safety dell pettus ankle did not return new york jets defensive lineman david onyemata groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the packers linebackers marcelino mccrary ball ankle and kiko mauigoa quad also did not return philadelphia eagles tight end dallas goedert knee did not return to sunday s win over the titans running back saquon barkley missed most of the first half after suffering a stinger barkley returned to the field after halftime barkley said after the game that he will undergo an mri pittsburgh steelers running back rico dowdle toe missed part of the first half of sunday s loss to the patriots before returning after halftime san francisco 49ers receiver demarcus robinson ankle was ruled out of sunday s game against the dolphins head coach kyle shanahan told reporters after the game robinson and dt james thompson have high ankle sprains wide receiver mike evans hip did not return to the game but the injury doesn t look serious per shanahan seattle seahawks running back jadarian price chest did not return to sunday s game against the cardinals hc mike macdonald said after the game that x rays came back negative on price s injury washington commanders quarterback jayden daniels dislocated his left elbow in sunday s loss to the cowboys head coach dan quinn said quinn told reporters that an x ray on daniels elbow didn t show a fracture but the qb will undergo more testing daniels was ruled out after getting injured at the end of the first half versus dallas he was seen leaving the stadium with his arm in a sling per local reporters sunday s game between the cleveland browns and tampa bay buccaneers was suspended in the fourth quarter due to lightning in the area the delay lasted over two hours before play resumed at 6 10 p m et

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: Ravens vs. Cowboys: Three must-know storylines for NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro
news_mentions.description: Is Ravens RB Derrick Henry about to run over the Cowboys once again? Jeremy Bergman breaks down three must-know storylines for Sunday's game between Baltimore and Dallas in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back in brazil this week for the third straight season once again pitting two high profile clubs in front of some of the world s most passionate fans it s a recipe for electric football but there are a few notable differences this time around for one after two years in sao paulo the league is making its regular season debut in brazil s second largest city rio de janeiro and its most iconic venue the maracana home to some of the most memorable moments in brazilian sporting history two world cups with unfortunate exits for the selecao the 2016 summer olympics the maracana used to hold nearly 200 000 spectators jerry jones cowboys who play in one of the nfl s largest stadiums will feel right at home in the cavernous confines the capacity is just over 73 000 nowadays but the roar undoubtedly remains another change after being played in friday week 1 island windows in 2024 and 25 this year s brazil game will kick off at 4 25 p m et on a sunday right in the middle of a four game late slate no offense to the cardinals 49ers vikings buccaneers raiders and saints but most eyes will be on baltimore and dallas in rio and deservedly so boasting two of the most explosive offenses and marketable quarterbacks in today s nfl the ravens and cowboys enter their international outing with somewhat disappointing 1 1 records and a lot to prove after a week 1 road rout of indianapolis baltimore blew a second half lead at home against the saints in week 2 the cowboys conversely were run over by the rival giants in week 1 only to crush the visiting commanders the following sunday both considered playoff division and super bowl contenders baltimore and dallas have a lot to work out in the season s early goings and will be doing so this week in unfamiliar territory the ravens are playing only their third ever game overseas while the cowboys will be embarking on just their second international voyage three must know storylines 1 is derrick henry due for another big day vs dallas d tractorcito bem vindo ao brasil the ravens running back hulking at 6 foot 3 and 252 pounds is set up for a monster day at the maracana as long as baltimore leans on the back in crunch time through two weeks henry ranked second in the league with 212 rushing yards while tying for the nfl lead with four scores on the ground the tailback might have been even more productive if he had received more than five carries in the second half of the ravens week 2 loss when the saints came back from an 11 point first half deficit the perfect remedy after last week s disappointing finish could be a date with the cowboys defense led by first year dc christian parker dallas hasn t stopped a nosebleed through two weeks ranking 29th in yards allowed per game 391 5 and 30th in rushing yards allowed per game 173 5 the cowboys are also dead last in third down conversion rate allowed 68 0 a bruiser like henry and an escape artist like lamar jackson are nightmares for a defense like dallas which struggled to contain cam skattebo and jaxson dart in week 1 allowing the giants to control the clock and salt away a win while the cowboys offense had two second half possessions just two years ago henry rolled over dallas to the tune of 174 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns with jackson tallying 87 yards and a td on the ground as well will the ravens runners have similar outings in the southern hemisphere this sunday 2 can the cowboys continue to roll offensively if week 1 was a liar as they say was week 2 the truth for the cowboys it s tough to say this early in the season with dallas jekyll and hyde offense the cowboys scored on seven of their eight drives against washington in their home opener and have consistently cooked defenses under brian schottenheimer all of which made their season opening dud in east rutherford see 244 total yards all the more surprising after the ravens struggled to defend through the air against chris olave juwan johnson and devaughn vele in week 2 dallas will look to hammer baltimore s dbs with a heavy dose of ceedee lamb and george pickens a dynamic duo that only occasionally has a case of the dropsies and tight end jake ferguson the key for the ravens will be getting pressure on dak prescott so far this season the qb has been beating the blitz with ease 78 3 completion percentage third in nfl but when under pressure he has struggled 50 his lowest mark since 2019 per nfl pro baltimore s defense boasts a 43 8 pressure rate this season the fifth highest in the nfl and has pressured qbs on 65 0 of third down dropbacks highest in the league if dallas can avoid third and long situations it may have a field day against baltimore but jesse minter s defense led by kyle hamilton roquan smith trey hendrickson and potentially nnamdi madubuike who might make his season debut on sunday will do its best to keep the cowboys behind the chains 3 play action advantage for baltimore playing off its success in the ground game baltimore could enjoy a big day in the play fake game against dallas through two games this season lamar jackson has completed 13 of his 18 play action pass attempts for an nfl high 229 yards while also taking off to run on four play action dropbacks for 36 scramble rush yards the top total in the league off play action per nfl pro meanwhile his opponent on sunday has allowed qbs to target a receiver with 3 plus yards of separation on 12 of 17 play action attempts this season 70 6 the second highest rate in the nfl and has also yielded a league high 61 scramble yards on play action dropbacks 24 more than the next closest team while jackson is making fewer plays on designed runs this year he remains the nfl s great improviser the dallas defense is determined to stay disciplined but with the unit struggling against play action baltimore s two time league mvp could break open the game either through the air or on the ground total football in brazil s cathedral of futebol

say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: Bears' Tyson Bagent clears concussion protocol ahead of Monday's game vs. Eagles; Caleb Williams out
news_mentions.description: Bears backup quarterback Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol and will practice Saturday ahead of Chicago's Monday night game against the Eagles, head coach Ben Johnson said.
news_mentions.body_text: the bears officially have a couple options at quarterback ahead of their monday night showdown with the eagles backup qb tyson bagent who on saturday was listed as questionable to play cleared concussion protocol on sunday and was removed from the injury report bagent progressed through protocol enough to practice in full during chicago s final practice of the week after missing the previous two sessions nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported that while ben johnson initially described bagent to reporters saturday morning as having cleared concussion protocol bagent actually progressed to the next step in the process which allowed him to practice after being symptom free into sunday bagent is in the clear though chicago hasn t named a starter with caleb williams ruled out due to a hamstring injury case keenum is also available and took starting snaps at the beginning of chicago s practice week with williams and bagent sidelined should the bears deem bagent is prepared enough to get the start it would be his first since the 2023 campaign when as an undrafted rookie he went 2 2 for the bears with 859 passing yards three touchdowns and six interceptions across five total appearances he also came in for williams on sunday against the vikings and went 5 of 9 for 54 yards during two fourth quarter possessions if the bears were to turn to keenum the 38 year old veteran would similarly be making his first start since 2023 he went 1 1 that season for the texans throwing for 291 yards one touchdown and three interceptions in what amounted to two of his four starts this decade regardless of who starts they ll have their work cut out for them against a philly defense that ranks fifth in the nfl against the pass through two weeks chicago measures up much better in the run game as the bears enter week 3 sporting the top rushing offense they ll likely look to attack the eagles 23rd ranked run defense on the ground with d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai however the passing game will still have a plethora of difference makers available in colston loveland rome odunze and luther burden as well as swift and monangai on shorter area targets we ll see what johnson draws up when the bears kick off against the eagles on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Zach Ertz silences the 'what-if' with Eagles return. Can he play Monday?
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia 34 obviously some things have changed around here 34 zach ertz said the tight end took in the locker room 34 a little bigger 34 he said he 39 d walked through the training room 34 a little better 34 he said he stood there smiling about a homecoming with the philadelphia eagles which he said was long overdue he stood there shifting his weight onto the right knee that made any return to football doubtful ertz tore the acl and lcl in that knee on dec 7 it was a violent injury it was an emotional injury it arrived near the end of his final one year contract with the washington commanders ertz 35 did not know if he would ever play again but he credited his wife julie and their three young boys with motivating his comeback he wanted to set an example for his sons to look back on when they face their own adversities 34 i was gonna do everything i could to get back and i could live with those results 34 ertz said 34 but if i couldn 39 t then i would know i 39 d be at peace but i couldn 39 t live with the fact that i just gave up and there was a 39 what if 39 hanging over my life for the rest of my life 34 now ertz 39 s name is hanging over a green laden locker he stood beneath it waxing nostalgic about 34 a place i 39 ve always called home 34 the eagles picked him no 35 in 2013 one round after right tackle lane johnson ertz got emotional seeing johnson again and owner jeffrey lurie and general manager howie roseman and facility staffers and even first time offensive coordinator sean mannion whom ertz had played against while growing up in california 39 s east bay 34 i beat him in high school 34 ertz said 34 just so we 39 re throwing that out there 34 just don 39 t say this reunion went all according to plan 34 i mean there was never a plan to come back obviously i never wanted to leave in the first place 34 said ertz whom the eagles traded in 2021 amid disagreements over a contract extension 34 the opportunity finally arose that i could come back there 39 s been times i 39 ve asked in the past and it didn 39 t come to fruition for whatever reason but for me it 39 s just a blessing to be back if you told me when i got hurt that i 39 d be back here in nine and a half months practicing for the philadelphia eagles you could have signed me up then 34 ertz 39 s homecoming is a heartening storyline it could culminate in ertz surpassing harold carmichael 39 s franchise record for career receptions he needs 11 catches though ertz said it 34 couldn 39 t be further from the truth 34 that he returned to chase the record practical matters are more pressing an in season problem prompted the eagles to bring ertz back starting tight end dallas goedert sprained his mcl against the tennessee titans and his weekslong recovery timeline effectively launched the break glass scenario for a precarious position group the franchise tried to strengthen in the offseason ertz 39 s own recovery remains an obstacle ertz said his right knee 34 feels great 34 but he acknowledged that he still needs to get it game ready after nearly 10 months away from the field it raises questions about how much ertz can contribute monday night against the chicago bears if the eagles promote him from the practice squad at all ertz must also learn a playbook he said is 34 all new to me 34 ertz acknowledged that he has never really played in an offense centered on the wide zone run game he said he 39 s spent the last few days 34 trying to do a crash course on this offense 34 which included poring over the team 39 s training camp playbooks he said there were maybe 34 two or three pass plays 34 left over from when coach nick sirianni installed his first ever playbook in 2021 sirianni said earlier thursday that the route concepts resemble those in other offenses ertz agreed the language of the plays is new which sirianni likened to someone learning french after speaking english on wednesday mannion gave ertz a vote of confidence saying his 14 year career reflects 34 a really strong record 34 as a 34 very very comfortable pass catcher 34 and a comfortable pass catcher is exactly what the eagles knew they might need managing injuries at tight end is not a new subject for them they arranged consecutive one year contracts for goedert partly due to the 31 year old 39 s injury history but they built their new offensive system around a clear need at tight end with goedert as the position group 39 s only proven pass catcher the other tight ends the eagles carried into the regular season have never totaled more than 20 catches in a season johnny mundt a 10 year veteran was a free agent upgrade for their blocking needs e j jenkins a 2023 practice squad pickup has been targeted once in his 132 career offensive snaps mannion said wednesday that despite what mundt 39 s and jenkins 39 statistical catalogs may say the eagles set being 34 a two way player 34 as a prerequisite for playing tight end in this system and that 34 we feel good about the group 34 roseman raved about jenkins 39 inclusion on the initial 53 man roster in august roseman underlined how jenkins was a former wide receiver at georgia tech who weighed 225 pounds in his final game jenkins is 6 foot 6 and 260 pounds after two years with the eagles roseman called jenkins an effective run blocker at the point of attack in their wide zone concepts and in pass protection but also noted his history as a wide receiver calling him 34 a big target in the passing game 34 34 i mean i know it hasn 39 t been put on display yet but it 39 s always going to be there 34 jenkins said 34 it 39 s not just going to disappear 34 second round pick eli stowers offers little short term insurance the 2025 mackey award winner for the nation 39 s top tight end offers undeniable upside as a pass catcher but the eagles saw stowers 39 lean frame and lack of blocking as a development project to meet the two way prerequisite their system requires stowers is now sidelined and so is depth tight end grant calcaterra who went on injured reserve aug 30 with a back injury the eagles placed stowers on ir with hamstring and quadriceps injuries the day before the regular season opener he must miss at least four games but his tepid progress before the injury casts doubt on how much he can contribute in 2026 roseman emphasized a 34 long term view 34 when discussing stowers at the end of training camp the eagles are still acting on that view they placed ertz in a locker next to stowers supplying young talent with veteran mentors is an organizational staple 34 i don 39 t think it 39 s an accident that they put me here 34 ertz said 34 everyone 39 s got a superpower in this league 34 ertz said of stowers 34 and he 39 s got to play to his superpower and i 39 m looking forward to helping him kind of unlock that mentally physically to be at his best 34 ertz was the eagles 39 most available option in their contingency plan ertz made his interest in a return to philly known throughout the offseason the eagles appeared cautious on the same day roseman addressed stowers 39 status with reporters he acknowledged that he 39 d spoken with ertz 34 over a period of time 34 to maintain their relationship and understand where ertz was in his recovery he balanced praise for ertz by calling him 34 one of the greatest tight ends to play the game 34 with a note that he was 34 excited about the tight ends that we have here 34 the tact behind roseman 39 s words reflected the politics at play in 2021 ertz was then at the same stage in his career as goedert is now ertz secured the contract he 39 d coveted in arizona five years later with ertz wanting to return to philly and the eagles wanting proven depth a reunion made sense 34 everything 39 s discussed everything has a plan 34 sirianni said 34 that 39 s what i appreciate so much about howie everything 39 s thought out everything 39 s got a plan and here we are today in the situation we 39 re in and zach being here i 39 m excited about that opportunity for him 34 the eagles have friday and saturday practices before they must make a decision about ertz if they aim to dress three tight ends against the bears their only other option right now is promoting josiah deguara from the practice squad deguara a seventh year veteran played in 12 games for the cardinals in 2025 in a blocking oriented role but ertz underlined that he isn 39 t yet even on the active roster it 39 s up to the coaches to decide whether his play in practice merits a return on monday night 34 it 39 s about going out there and proving that i can make a difference in the game 34 ertz said 34 if i can 39 t make a difference in the game then i shouldn 39 t be out there 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Ravens vs. Cowboys: Three must-know storylines for NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro
news_mentions.description: Is Ravens RB Derrick Henry about to run over the Cowboys once again? Jeremy Bergman breaks down three must-know storylines for Sunday's game between Baltimore and Dallas in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back in brazil this week for the third straight season once again pitting two high profile clubs in front of some of the world s most passionate fans it s a recipe for electric football but there are a few notable differences this time around for one after two years in sao paulo the league is making its regular season debut in brazil s second largest city rio de janeiro and its most iconic venue the maracana home to some of the most memorable moments in brazilian sporting history two world cups with unfortunate exits for the selecao the 2016 summer olympics the maracana used to hold nearly 200 000 spectators jerry jones cowboys who play in one of the nfl s largest stadiums will feel right at home in the cavernous confines the capacity is just over 73 000 nowadays but the roar undoubtedly remains another change after being played in friday week 1 island windows in 2024 and 25 this year s brazil game will kick off at 4 25 p m et on a sunday right in the middle of a four game late slate no offense to the cardinals 49ers vikings buccaneers raiders and saints but most eyes will be on baltimore and dallas in rio and deservedly so boasting two of the most explosive offenses and marketable quarterbacks in today s nfl the ravens and cowboys enter their international outing with somewhat disappointing 1 1 records and a lot to prove after a week 1 road rout of indianapolis baltimore blew a second half lead at home against the saints in week 2 the cowboys conversely were run over by the rival giants in week 1 only to crush the visiting commanders the following sunday both considered playoff division and super bowl contenders baltimore and dallas have a lot to work out in the season s early goings and will be doing so this week in unfamiliar territory the ravens are playing only their third ever game overseas while the cowboys will be embarking on just their second international voyage three must know storylines 1 is derrick henry due for another big day vs dallas d tractorcito bem vindo ao brasil the ravens running back hulking at 6 foot 3 and 252 pounds is set up for a monster day at the maracana as long as baltimore leans on the back in crunch time through two weeks henry ranked second in the league with 212 rushing yards while tying for the nfl lead with four scores on the ground the tailback might have been even more productive if he had received more than five carries in the second half of the ravens week 2 loss when the saints came back from an 11 point first half deficit the perfect remedy after last week s disappointing finish could be a date with the cowboys defense led by first year dc christian parker dallas hasn t stopped a nosebleed through two weeks ranking 29th in yards allowed per game 391 5 and 30th in rushing yards allowed per game 173 5 the cowboys are also dead last in third down conversion rate allowed 68 0 a bruiser like henry and an escape artist like lamar jackson are nightmares for a defense like dallas which struggled to contain cam skattebo and jaxson dart in week 1 allowing the giants to control the clock and salt away a win while the cowboys offense had two second half possessions just two years ago henry rolled over dallas to the tune of 174 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns with jackson tallying 87 yards and a td on the ground as well will the ravens runners have similar outings in the southern hemisphere this sunday 2 can the cowboys continue to roll offensively if week 1 was a liar as they say was week 2 the truth for the cowboys it s tough to say this early in the season with dallas jekyll and hyde offense the cowboys scored on seven of their eight drives against washington in their home opener and have consistently cooked defenses under brian schottenheimer all of which made their season opening dud in east rutherford see 244 total yards all the more surprising after the ravens struggled to defend through the air against chris olave juwan johnson and devaughn vele in week 2 dallas will look to hammer baltimore s dbs with a heavy dose of ceedee lamb and george pickens a dynamic duo that only occasionally has a case of the dropsies and tight end jake ferguson the key for the ravens will be getting pressure on dak prescott so far this season the qb has been beating the blitz with ease 78 3 completion percentage third in nfl but when under pressure he has struggled 50 his lowest mark since 2019 per nfl pro baltimore s defense boasts a 43 8 pressure rate this season the fifth highest in the nfl and has pressured qbs on 65 0 of third down dropbacks highest in the league if dallas can avoid third and long situations it may have a field day against baltimore but jesse minter s defense led by kyle hamilton roquan smith trey hendrickson and potentially nnamdi madubuike who might make his season debut on sunday will do its best to keep the cowboys behind the chains 3 play action advantage for baltimore playing off its success in the ground game baltimore could enjoy a big day in the play fake game against dallas through two games this season lamar jackson has completed 13 of his 18 play action pass attempts for an nfl high 229 yards while also taking off to run on four play action dropbacks for 36 scramble rush yards the top total in the league off play action per nfl pro meanwhile his opponent on sunday has allowed qbs to target a receiver with 3 plus yards of separation on 12 of 17 play action attempts this season 70 6 the second highest rate in the nfl and has also yielded a league high 61 scramble yards on play action dropbacks 24 more than the next closest team while jackson is making fewer plays on designed runs this year he remains the nfl s great improviser the dallas defense is determined to stay disciplined but with the unit struggling against play action baltimore s two time league mvp could break open the game either through the air or on the ground total football in brazil s cathedral of futebol

news_mentions.headline: Bengals backup Joe Flacco doesn't expect trade to Giants after Jaxson Dart injury: 'Not true'
news_mentions.description: Bengals backup Joe Flacco’s ties to Giants coach John Harbaugh make the 41-year-old an interesting trade target. However, Flacco doesn’t plan on leaving the Queen City.
news_mentions.body_text: with jaxson dart out for the season and jameis winston struggling in his stead the rumor mill has churned out potential trade options for the new york giants should winston continue to look like a player who spent his summer on the world cup tour cincinnati bengals backup joe flacco s ties to john harbaugh from their time in baltimore make the 41 year old an interesting target however flacco doesn t plan on leaving the queen city it s obviously not real and not true flacco told kelsey conway of the cincinnati enquirer about trade rumors but it was good enough to get people like certain friends of mine to get them to text me hey i ll see you in new york i was like no guys you won t that s not true given joe burrow s injury history it makes little to no sense for the bengals to trade flacco even with a veteran like josh johnson on the practice squad if burrow goes down for a spell flacco is the best option to keep things afloat i just get a kick out of it he said i haven t really given it too much thought at this point last year flacco wasn t aware he was being traded from cleveland to cincinnati so anything can happen but there is minuscule incentive for the bengals to trade their top backup or the giants to part with an asset for a 41 year old who isn t going to change their season long trajectory regardless of his relationship with the head coach in these cases it s not up to me flacco said i m on the cincinnati bengals and because of that that s my focus being here doing the things that i need to do to get better each day while i m here make sure i m absorbing the game plan and all of those things i get a little bit of a kick out of it but it s kind out of my hands i m a cincinnati bengal and i m doing everything i can to get ready for the pittsburgh steelers the giants recently gave winston an extension he ll get a chance to run the offense before new york hits the panic button if winston is so awful that big blue is desperate for qb help the season is probably lost anyway backups with experience like flacco will always be named as potential candidates whenever a starter goes down just because there are speculative rumors doesn t mean a trade makes sense for either party

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs want to lighten Kenneth Walker's workload after 56 touches in two games
news_mentions.description: Kenneth Walker III has rejuvenated the Kansas City offense, bringing a tackle-breaking ground element that had been missing. The Chiefs, however, know they mustn’t grind the RB into the ground.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth walker has rejuvenated the kansas city chiefs offense bringing a tackle breaking ground element that had been missing the chiefs however know they mustn t grind the rb into the ground coach andy reid said this week the club would like to reduce walker s workload a little bit heading into week 3 walker led the nfl with 290 rushing yards and 369 scrimmage yards in 2026 two touchdowns after thursday night football bijan robinson now leads with 349 and 467 respectively walker s rushing yard tally marks the most by any nfl player through two weeks since c j spiller in 2012 292 walker is on pace for 2 465 rush yards which would be an nfl record by 360 yards he s also tied with jahmyr gibbs with 56 scrimmage touches we re lucky to have him running backs coach demarco murray said thursday via espn he s a great leader and he s done a great job for us he s prepared himself for this workload since the spring coach reid puts a great training camp together and the long drive drill is legendary around here walker likes the ball a lot walker s 369 scrimmage yards are the second most by a player in his first two games with a team in the super bowl era only billy sims had more with the lions the back has forced 29 missed tackles in 2026 per next gen stats most through two weeks in ngs era the key is balance and ensuring walker who never played a full 17 game slate before last season remains healthy to that end the chiefs plan to give rookie emmett johnson who has also flashed tackle breaking acumen more run we just want to continue to make sure we re bringing our rookies along the right way offensive coordinator eric bieniemy said thursday emmett s role is to continue to grow as the season progresses what you don t want to do when you re raising some of these young players is put them in a situation where it could be detrimental to them you want them feeling free and confident through two games johnson has generated 10 rushes for 39 yards and four catches for 64 yards 103 scrimmage yards the plan is to get the rookie more carries starting with sunday s game against the miami dolphins i want kenneth to get into a groove and it s hard to kind of take him out murray said but emmett s done a great job and he s still learning he ll continue to get more opportunities i ve just got to pull the trigger and get no 9 walker out of there and put no 10 johnson in there

news_mentions.headline: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? Plus, three disappointing units
news_mentions.description: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks provides game plans for two of the NFL's toughest assignments. Plus, three wildly disappointing units in the young season.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three units experiencing serious struggles in the young season but first a look at a prolific offense and a devastating defense the season is only a few weeks old but no units have shined brighter than the buffalo bills offense and minnesota vikings defense joe brady and brian flores have unlocked their jimmys and joes by cleverly deploying the x s and o s on the grassy chessboard with both teams sitting atop their respective divisions at 2 0 the rest of the league is trying to figure out how to slow down the bills explosive offense and block the vikings blitz happy defense after digging into the all 22 film on nfl pro here are three keys to tackling two of the league s toughest assignments in 2026 three keys to stopping the bills offense 1 play keep away reducing the number of possessions buffalo receives is the best way to neutralize one of the league s most explosive offenses josh allen and co cannot score if they don t have the ball so a ball control strategy designed to shrink the game is the no 1 objective for a team facing this juggernaut this season the bills are averaging just 28 44 in time of possession 24th in the nfl while running 60 5 offensive plays per game 15th but they lead the league in scoring 38 5 ppg and rank second in total offense 427 5 ypg given the bills explosive potential and efficient production opposing coaches should build game plans around a complementary football strategy that emphasizes a slower offensive pace from taking the play clock down to five seconds or fewer before snapping the ball to staying in bounds on perimeter runs every offensive player must understand the turtle approach being employed to keep buffalo s high powered offense on the sidelines by reducing total possessions and plays opponents can ramp up pressure on the bills offense to do more with less although the ultra efficient unit has set off fireworks with limited possessions thus far the slowdown strategy gives opponents a better chance to win with stops and turnovers which are at a higher premium in a low possession game 2 make josh allen win from the pocket the 2024 nfl mvp is one of the league s most dangerous playmakers having eclipsed 35 total touchdowns for six straight seasons in each of the past three campaigns the 6 foot 5 237 pounder has logged at least 25 passing tds and 12 rushing scores a feat no other quarterback has ever accomplished although he is an explosive pocket passer with exceptional range allen is an unstoppable force when he uses his athleticism and running skills to create big plays on the perimeter whether picking up first downs on designed quarterback runs or impromptu scrambles run around tosses the four time pro bowler terrorizes defenses when he flees the pocket to counter his big play potential defensive coordinators must implement a pass rush plan that has everyone rush to the depth of his drop in order to restrict escape lanes in the pocket additionally pass rushers must work together to create a coordinated mush rush as opposed to operating as independent contractors attacking no 17 with random 1 on 1 pass rush maneuvers defensive coordinators also need to account for allen s impact on designed quarterback runs particularly in goal line and short yardage situations the supersized playmaker has a knack for moving the chains and or finding the paint on quarterback powers following direct snaps or flash fakes in the backfield defensive play callers must assign a defender to the quarterback to prevent the bills from capitalizing on the plus one advantage created by a running qb finally the bills signal caller must be kept in check in the gotta have it moments when he is prone to leave the pocket while operating in playmaker mode allen has routinely relied on his improvisational skills on third down in the red zone and in two minute situations so defenders must be aware of his tendencies in those moments to minimize his impact while containing allen is easier said than done the most successful defenses against buffalo have made the superstar a one dimensional threat 3 take away the middle of the field the bills made a blockbuster trade in march to acquire a wr1 in dj moore but the team s dynamic tight end duo of dalton kincaid and dawson knox is the linchpin of the passing game kincaid in particular has emerged as buffalo s top pass catcher with his speed quickness and ball skills posing problems for linebackers and safeties matching up with him the 2023 first rounder leads the team in targets 14 receptions 12 and receiving yards 225 doing most of his damage on short and intermediate routes between the numbers in addition kincaid is a sneaky vertical threat who routinely cruises past defenders on seam routes since 2024 allen has totaled 11 completions for 253 yards and three touchdowns when targeting kincaid on open downfield throws 3 plus yards of target separation and 10 plus air yards per next gen stats given the playmaking tight end s impact opponents must shut down the middle of the field and force allen to find completions elsewhere by jamming the middle with a robber safety or utilizing bracket coverage with a linebacker and safety assigned to kincaid the defense can put the onus on moore and others to win their 1 on 1 matchups on the perimeter despite the fanfare around moore s arrival and his eye popping yards per catch average thus far 20 0 the bills inside out passing game is nearly impossible to stop when their no 1 tight end is getting loose over the middle by limiting kincaid s impact and forcing buffalo to rely on a complementary pass catcher to carry the aerial attack opponents can hope the tactics disrupt a well oiled machine that is already in midseason form three keys to surviving the vikings defense 1 crack the code vikings dc brian flores exotic pressures and unorthodox coverage patterns are masked by a clever series of pre snap disguises that befuddle quarterbacks at the line of scrimmage with the organized chaos creating hesitation and doubt for novice and experienced passers opposing coaching staffs should operate at a quicker pace to give their quarterbacks access to the offensive coordinator at the line of scrimmage communication devices shut off with 15 seconds left on the play clock and allow for double cadence calls qb barks out the signals and fakes a snap count before re assessing the defense and repeating the process with a different play call based on the defensive look those kinds of tactics force the vikings to reveal their plans while plenty of quarterbacks have attempted these techniques against flores aggressive approach the vikings snowflake game plans make it hard to predict how the defense will align after the snap as a zone blitz heavy outfit minnesota s d balances ultra aggressive six man hot pressures with three man rushes drop eight coverages consequently quarterbacks are lured into a high stakes guessing game that ultimately produces mistakes and turnovers against a unit that relies heavily on blitzes and chaos a quicker tempo produces more vanilla defensive looks due to communication and alignment assignment issues with so many tempo ploys available to offensive coordinators the best game plan should mix no huddle sugar huddle and fast break tactics that eliminate the time minnesota needs to run intricate pre snap disguises 2 win early downs with quicks screens and runs if opponents want to avoid the chaotic pressures flores likes to employ on third down they must stay on schedule by gaining 4 plus yards on first down using a mix of quick throws screens and downhill runs to keep minnesota defenders guessing considering minnesota s ridiculous blitz rate thus far this season 75 percent nearly 30 percent more than anyone else the ball has to come out quickly to keep the quarterback upright in the pocket although the vikings utilize vision and break blitz zones with defenders keying the quarterback catch and throw routes are the best way to consistently pick up 5 yard gains whether targeting running backs tight ends or wide receivers on swings quick outs hitches or slants the high percentage throws create a series of 1 on 1 tackling drills that test the defense s prowess in space moreover it gives the offense a chance to produce some chunk plays on easy throws given how challenging it is to tackle early in the season due to limited reps in preseason and training camp it makes sense to test minnesota s defensive backs on the perimeter if a few quick passes turn into big plays after missed tackles the ultra aggressive play caller might have to scale back some of his exotics to settle down his troops beyond the screens and quick game strategies opponents must run the ball at the vikings despite minnesota s heavy use of six man pressures that snuff out many running plays a persistent ground attack keeps the game plan from turning into a one dimensional call sheet more suited to a 7 on 7 passing competition the vikings rank 13th in rush defense with opponents averaging 100 yards per game on the ground although those numbers are solid for a defense that aims to harass quarterbacks and create turnovers it suggests opponents might be able to carve out some room on the ground with early down runs to stay on schedule against a d that wants to create chaos at every turn 3 take your shot flores is unapologetically aggressive following a live by the blitz die by the blitz creed that scares some offensive play callers into submission however the aggressive pressure tactics create plenty of big play opportunities if the protection holds up at the line of scrimmage with that in mind quarterbacks must attack the pressure with scripted deep balls that punish the vikings for leaving their defensive backs on islands whether using max protection out of run heavy sets on second third and short situations or taking a shot on first down opponents must consistently threaten the vikes downfield to keep their defensive backs from squatting on short and intermediate routes moreover the selective deep shots could make flores reconsider some of his choices if his unit surrenders a big play or two early in the contest remember the packers raced out to a lead against the vikings in week 1 by taking a few shots to christian watson tucker kraft and jonnu smith by flipping the script on the vikings and attacking their pressure with long bombs opponents can dictate the terms to the defense and turn minnesota s aggressive approach into a favorable situation three wildly disappointing units can they be fixed while the bills offense and vikings defense have opened the 2026 campaign in style several units have seriously stumbled out of the gates i d like to spotlight three that have been particularly awful
