news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Detroit Lions' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the detroit lions offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 16 rookies july 19 veterans location detroit lions training facility allen park michigan fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule pro football hall of fame game vs los angeles chargers thursday july 31 at 8 p m et nbc week 1 at atlanta falcons friday aug 8 at 7 p m et week 2 vs miami dolphins saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs houston texans saturday aug 23 at 1 p m et 2025 schedule note the lions have 11 games against 2024 playoff teams tied with the eagles for most in the nfl nfl research what you need to know 1 who will replace frank ragnow the abrupt retirement of the star center tossed a massive question mark into the lions den presumably the club hoped to get one more year out of the stalwart pivot who played through an assortment of injuries throughout his career that would have allowed rookie tate ratledge to get his feet wet at guard before transitioning to center in 2026 much the same way ragnow started his career now things are turned topsy turvy is the second round rookie ready to start under center like 30 other second round picks he remains unsigned as camp approaches which could toss another kink into the lions plans can veteran graham glasgow return to center for the start of the season the 32 year old struggled last season at guard and hasn t consistently played center since the end of the 2022 campaign fifth round rookie miles frazier could also play a key role this season particularly if injuries strike with second year guard christian mahogany already slated to take over for guard kevin zeitler who left in free agency the lions could be uber young in the middle of the offensive line in front of jared goff a strength of the 2024 squad the offensive line has big questions heading into training camp 2 coming off a 15 2 season and back to back nfc north championships the lions are replacing both coordinators who left for head coaching jobs dan campbell knew he could trust ben johnson and aaron glenn to pull the right plays and build a reliable game plan week in and week out now he ll have to construct that same trust with new offensive coordinator john morton and defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard working under glenn since he became an nfl coach in 2021 sheppard was a natural choice to step into the dc role however he s green as a play caller and there will be questions about how he handles in game adjustments glenn kept a defense decimated by injuries afloat last season until the playoffs how would sheppard fare if similar devastation occurs likewise morton enters with big shoes to fill the lions offense was a dual threat nightmare for defenses and johnson was a master at setting up defenses to fail will morton who doesn t have a ton of play calling experience continue that with a trove of offensive weapons or could we see a step back from detroit s offense morton s familiarity with goff is a benefit but questions remain as to how he ll tweak the scheme like potentially splitting out wide jahmyr gibbs more often it s difficult to imagine the lions getting better management from their coordinators than they had a year ago any step back could be a detriment in a tough division training camp will give us our first real taste of how the new coordinators plan to change things or not in 2025 3 aidan hutchinson has been cleared from last year s devastating injury given the timeline it s not a surprise that the pass rusher is raring to go but it will be good to see him live during camp how he attacks those first few days of practice and recovers from them will give a good indication as to whether he can get back to the defensive player of the year trajectory he was on pre injury or whether we should curtail our expectations hutchinson s health isn t the only one to track in detroit alim mcneill is expected to miss the early part of the season but how much remains to be seen how does marcus davenport look after yet another injury shortened season there are questions at edge rusher in detroit so the health of the front four is particularly notable at this early stage

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Michael Baca provides a refresher on the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the tampa bay buccaneers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location adventhealth training center tampa florida fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs tennessee titans 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs buffalo bills 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the buccaneers who won six of their final seven regular season games in 2024 end the 2025 campaign with six consecutive games against teams that missed the playoffs nfl research what you need to know 1 a new challenge has reared its head just ahead of buccaneers training camp find an early season replacement for tristan wirfs the all pro left tackle underwent knee surgery on july 8 and is likely to begin the season on the physically unable to perform list which would sideline him at least four games there s no replacing the only player in nfl history who has earned all pro honors at both tackle positions but the silver lining is there s plenty of time to prepare currently on the left tackle depth chart are veteran charlie heck a newcomer and undrafted rookie benjamin chukwuma but perhaps a temporary reshuffling is in order will luke goedeke try his hand at a tackle switch or will left guard ben bredeson another newcomer man the position it s too early to tell now but figuring it out will be a camp priority tampa begins the 2025 season with two road games and hosts the defending super bowl champions in week 4 with wirfs likely out 2 the buccaneers surged toward their fourth consecutive nfc title last season thanks to balanced offense that consistently put up points the unit returns in 2025 largely unchanged barring the availability of wirfs but one other facet of the offense that could be interesting over the next few months is how the depth chart shakes out at wide receiver with mike evans leading the way chris godwin s health and potential return to form is the first item to monitor the bucs are hopeful the veteran wr will be ready for week 1 after a brutal ankle dislocation disrupted a fantastic season in 2024 but the club seems to be prepared either way that s where the head scratching begins tampa selected emeka egbuka with the 19th overall pick and the ohio state product seems poised for the slot role especially with godwin s guidance jalen mcmillan came on strong late last season and is in line for more playing time in year 2 add in veteran sterling shepard trey palmer and seventh rounder tez johnson to the mix and therein lies a good problem to have for the bucs 3 haason reddick was the biggest offseason addition for a buccaneers team that is in need of pressure off the edges defensive tackles vita vea and calijah kancey led the team in sacks in 2024 following a lengthy contract squabble that spilled into the regular season reddick s lone campaign with the jets was one to forget but a new beginning in tampa bay could be what the two time pro bowler needs reddick who previously had four consecutive 10 plus sack seasons before 2024 joins an aggressive todd bowles scheme that will lean on his pass rushing talents and bring him opportunity to cash in on his one year deal there s also a fourth round pick to watch david walker the highest nfl draftee ever from central arkansas had coaches buzzing after rookie minicamp

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Jeremy Bergman provides a refresher on the Philadelphia Eagles' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the philadelphia eagles offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location novacare complex philadelphia fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cincinnati bengals 7 30 p m et on thursday aug 7 week 2 vs cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 at new york jets 7 30 p m et on friday aug 22 2025 schedule note the eagles are the only team currently scheduled to play on five or more days of the week during the 2025 regular season sunday monday thursday friday saturday the chargers are set to play on four different days with the possibility of a fifth if their week 17 game currently tbd takes place on saturday nfl research what you need to know 1 there aren t many holes on the eagles roster entering the 2025 season that s what you d expect from the reigning super bowl champions with one of the youngest nuclei in football but there are a number of questions to be answered on the defensive side of the ball after a slew of departures out are josh sweat oren burks darius slay and chauncey gardner johnson four super bowl starters plus milton williams and the retired brandon graham that s 4 070 combined defensive snaps regular season and postseason and a lot of experience for which to compensate even for roster building whiz howie roseman and defensive guru vic fangio philly has backfilled well with its own talent plus a few notable additions in first rounder jihaad campbell pass rushers josh uche and azeez ojulari and cornerback adoree 39 jackson but how and how quickly the new look unit gels will be the focus of camp 2 what does saquon barkley s sequel look like after his historic 2 000 yard debut season with the eagles the madden nfl 26 cover athlete has reached the pinnacle of his sport with not much left to conquer the super bowl champ s renegotiated 20 6m aav deal is now the most expensive ever for a running back philly returns the same offense this season priming barkley for another opportunity to gash defenses behind arguably the league s top offensive line the eagles will likely lighten the star rb s load in training camp and preseason potentially save for an aug 13 joint practice with cleveland but if he shows the same burst and ability after an offseason of celebration could we be looking at our first two time 2k rusher 3 the eagles boast great continuity on the offensive roster but they ll have a new play caller and coordinator in 2025 kevin patullo was promoted to offensive coordinator after kellen moore left to be the saints head coach essentially minutes after their super bowl victory patullo will be philly s fourth offensive coordinator in as many years under nick sirianni shane steichen left for indy after the 2022 campaign and brian johnson was bounced after 23 the annual turnover at oc is historic sirianni is the first head coach to have four different ocs excluding interims in a four season span for one team since the merger and yet the eagles offense remains remarkably proficient year to year will that change with patullo s elevation he s been around the team since 2021 through the highs and lows of two super bowl berths and one embarrassing collapse our first glimpse at philly s identity under patullo will come in camp this summer

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the tampa bay buccaneers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location adventhealth training center tampa florida fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs tennessee titans 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs buffalo bills 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the buccaneers who won six of their final seven regular season games in 2024 end the 2025 campaign with six consecutive games against teams that missed the playoffs nfl research what you need to know 1 a new challenge has reared its head just ahead of buccaneers training camp find an early season replacement for tristan wirfs the all pro left tackle underwent knee surgery on july 8 and is likely to begin the season on the physically unable to perform list which would sideline him at least four games there s no replacing the only player in nfl history who has earned all pro honors at both tackle positions but the silver lining is there s plenty of time to prepare currently on the left tackle depth chart are veteran charlie heck a newcomer and undrafted rookie benjamin chukwuma but perhaps a temporary reshuffling is in order will luke goedeke try his hand at a tackle switch or will left guard ben bredeson another newcomer man the position it s too early to tell now but figuring it out will be a camp priority tampa begins the 2025 season with two road games and hosts the defending super bowl champions in week 4 with wirfs likely out 2 the buccaneers surged toward their fourth consecutive nfc title last season thanks to balanced offense that consistently put up points the unit returns in 2025 largely unchanged barring the availability of wirfs but one other facet of the offense that could be interesting over the next few months is how the depth chart shakes out at wide receiver with mike evans leading the way chris godwin s health and potential return to form is the first item to monitor the bucs are hopeful the veteran wr will be ready for week 1 after a brutal ankle dislocation disrupted a fantastic season in 2024 but the club seems to be prepared either way that s where the head scratching begins tampa selected emeka egbuka with the 19th overall pick and the ohio state product seems poised for the slot role especially with godwin s guidance jalen mcmillan came on strong late last season and is in line for more playing time in year 2 add in veteran sterling shepard trey palmer and seventh rounder tez johnson to the mix and therein lies a good problem to have for the bucs 3 haason reddick was the biggest offseason addition for a buccaneers team that is in need of pressure off the edges defensive tackles vita vea and calijah kancey led the team in sacks in 2024 following a lengthy contract squabble that spilled into the regular season reddick s lone campaign with the jets was one to forget but a new beginning in tampa bay could be what the two time pro bowler needs reddick who previously had four consecutive 10 plus sack seasons before 2024 joins an aggressive todd bowles scheme that will lean on his pass rushing talents and bring him opportunity to cash in on his one year deal there s also a fourth round pick to watch david walker the highest nfl draftee ever from central arkansas had coaches buzzing after rookie minicamp

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the carolina panthers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location bank of america stadium charlotte north carolina fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cleveland browns 7 p m et nfl network on friday aug 8 week 2 at houston texans 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et nfl network on thursday aug 21 2025 schedule note the panthers are one of just seven teams that do not have a thursday game on their schedule their monday night matchup with san francisco in week 12 is currently slated to be their only prime time game of the 2025 regular season nfl research what you need to know 1 bryce young s growth in the last half of 2024 was the silver lining of yet another lost season in carolina and furthering his development will be a primary focus over training camp the panthers helped that cause in april with the first round selection of tetairoa mcmillan who possesses the typical traits of a true no 1 wide receiver and offers young a rangy target as the quarterback enters year 3 establishing chemistry with mcmillan is crucial for an immediate impact and having veteran adam thielen around figures to aid that process xavier legette s development entering his second season is also essential to forming a dynamic group weapons for young to utilize hunter renfrow s comeback attempt in carolina is another subplot to keep an eye on over the summer as the panthers aim to build around their franchise quarterback 2 derrick brown s return in 2025 won t be only thing to anticipate for the panthers defense defensive linemen tershawn wharton and bobby brown are key free agent additions joining carolina s star defender and the initial gelling of this reimagined defensive front is worth monitoring the panthers lacked any push without brown who suffered a season ending knee injury in week 1 and their run stopping troubles spiraled into last season s 32nd ranked defense a turnaround up front could do wonders for a unit with a talented secondary headed by jaycee horn and mike jackson the panthers also added pass rusher patrick jones and safety tre 39 von moehrig via free agency rookies nic scourton and lathan ransom are also in the mix for playing time 3 kickoff and punt returns might bring some added excitement along carolina s preseason both primary roles are up for grabs this summer and a pair of rookies wr jimmy horn and running back trevor etienne are expected to compete for both jobs the pairing is small in size but brings plenty of speed and shiftiness to a club that has produced just one touchdown return since 2018 the panthers oncoming work on special teams doesn t stop with figuring out the returners either with new kickers matthew wright and ryan fitzgerald battling for the starting role and new punter sam martin holding for longtime long snapper j j jansen

news_mentions.headline: Bears' Tyson Bagent clears concussion protocol ahead of Monday's game vs. Eagles; Caleb Williams out
news_mentions.description: Bears backup quarterback Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol and will practice Saturday ahead of Chicago's Monday night game against the Eagles, head coach Ben Johnson said.
news_mentions.body_text: the bears officially have a couple options at quarterback ahead of their monday night showdown with the eagles backup qb tyson bagent who on saturday was listed as questionable to play cleared concussion protocol on sunday and was removed from the injury report bagent progressed through protocol enough to practice in full during chicago s final practice of the week after missing the previous two sessions nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported that while ben johnson initially described bagent to reporters saturday morning as having cleared concussion protocol bagent actually progressed to the next step in the process which allowed him to practice after being symptom free into sunday bagent is in the clear though chicago hasn t named a starter with caleb williams ruled out due to a hamstring injury case keenum is also available and took starting snaps at the beginning of chicago s practice week with williams and bagent sidelined should the bears deem bagent is prepared enough to get the start it would be his first since the 2023 campaign when as an undrafted rookie he went 2 2 for the bears with 859 passing yards three touchdowns and six interceptions across five total appearances he also came in for williams on sunday against the vikings and went 5 of 9 for 54 yards during two fourth quarter possessions if the bears were to turn to keenum the 38 year old veteran would similarly be making his first start since 2023 he went 1 1 that season for the texans throwing for 291 yards one touchdown and three interceptions in what amounted to two of his four starts this decade regardless of who starts they ll have their work cut out for them against a philly defense that ranks fifth in the nfl against the pass through two weeks chicago measures up much better in the run game as the bears enter week 3 sporting the top rushing offense they ll likely look to attack the eagles 23rd ranked run defense on the ground with d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai however the passing game will still have a plethora of difference makers available in colston loveland rome odunze and luther burden as well as swift and monangai on shorter area targets we ll see what johnson draws up when the bears kick off against the eagles on monday at 8 15 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Zach Ertz silences the 'what-if' with Eagles return. Can he play Monday?
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia 34 obviously some things have changed around here 34 zach ertz said the tight end took in the locker room 34 a little bigger 34 he said he 39 d walked through the training room 34 a little better 34 he said he stood there smiling about a homecoming with the philadelphia eagles which he said was long overdue he stood there shifting his weight onto the right knee that made any return to football doubtful ertz tore the acl and lcl in that knee on dec 7 it was a violent injury it was an emotional injury it arrived near the end of his final one year contract with the washington commanders ertz 35 did not know if he would ever play again but he credited his wife julie and their three young boys with motivating his comeback he wanted to set an example for his sons to look back on when they face their own adversities 34 i was gonna do everything i could to get back and i could live with those results 34 ertz said 34 but if i couldn 39 t then i would know i 39 d be at peace but i couldn 39 t live with the fact that i just gave up and there was a 39 what if 39 hanging over my life for the rest of my life 34 now ertz 39 s name is hanging over a green laden locker he stood beneath it waxing nostalgic about 34 a place i 39 ve always called home 34 the eagles picked him no 35 in 2013 one round after right tackle lane johnson ertz got emotional seeing johnson again and owner jeffrey lurie and general manager howie roseman and facility staffers and even first time offensive coordinator sean mannion whom ertz had played against while growing up in california 39 s east bay 34 i beat him in high school 34 ertz said 34 just so we 39 re throwing that out there 34 just don 39 t say this reunion went all according to plan 34 i mean there was never a plan to come back obviously i never wanted to leave in the first place 34 said ertz whom the eagles traded in 2021 amid disagreements over a contract extension 34 the opportunity finally arose that i could come back there 39 s been times i 39 ve asked in the past and it didn 39 t come to fruition for whatever reason but for me it 39 s just a blessing to be back if you told me when i got hurt that i 39 d be back here in nine and a half months practicing for the philadelphia eagles you could have signed me up then 34 ertz 39 s homecoming is a heartening storyline it could culminate in ertz surpassing harold carmichael 39 s franchise record for career receptions he needs 11 catches though ertz said it 34 couldn 39 t be further from the truth 34 that he returned to chase the record practical matters are more pressing an in season problem prompted the eagles to bring ertz back starting tight end dallas goedert sprained his mcl against the tennessee titans and his weekslong recovery timeline effectively launched the break glass scenario for a precarious position group the franchise tried to strengthen in the offseason ertz 39 s own recovery remains an obstacle ertz said his right knee 34 feels great 34 but he acknowledged that he still needs to get it game ready after nearly 10 months away from the field it raises questions about how much ertz can contribute monday night against the chicago bears if the eagles promote him from the practice squad at all ertz must also learn a playbook he said is 34 all new to me 34 ertz acknowledged that he has never really played in an offense centered on the wide zone run game he said he 39 s spent the last few days 34 trying to do a crash course on this offense 34 which included poring over the team 39 s training camp playbooks he said there were maybe 34 two or three pass plays 34 left over from when coach nick sirianni installed his first ever playbook in 2021 sirianni said earlier thursday that the route concepts resemble those in other offenses ertz agreed the language of the plays is new which sirianni likened to someone learning french after speaking english on wednesday mannion gave ertz a vote of confidence saying his 14 year career reflects 34 a really strong record 34 as a 34 very very comfortable pass catcher 34 and a comfortable pass catcher is exactly what the eagles knew they might need managing injuries at tight end is not a new subject for them they arranged consecutive one year contracts for goedert partly due to the 31 year old 39 s injury history but they built their new offensive system around a clear need at tight end with goedert as the position group 39 s only proven pass catcher the other tight ends the eagles carried into the regular season have never totaled more than 20 catches in a season johnny mundt a 10 year veteran was a free agent upgrade for their blocking needs e j jenkins a 2023 practice squad pickup has been targeted once in his 132 career offensive snaps mannion said wednesday that despite what mundt 39 s and jenkins 39 statistical catalogs may say the eagles set being 34 a two way player 34 as a prerequisite for playing tight end in this system and that 34 we feel good about the group 34 roseman raved about jenkins 39 inclusion on the initial 53 man roster in august roseman underlined how jenkins was a former wide receiver at georgia tech who weighed 225 pounds in his final game jenkins is 6 foot 6 and 260 pounds after two years with the eagles roseman called jenkins an effective run blocker at the point of attack in their wide zone concepts and in pass protection but also noted his history as a wide receiver calling him 34 a big target in the passing game 34 34 i mean i know it hasn 39 t been put on display yet but it 39 s always going to be there 34 jenkins said 34 it 39 s not just going to disappear 34 second round pick eli stowers offers little short term insurance the 2025 mackey award winner for the nation 39 s top tight end offers undeniable upside as a pass catcher but the eagles saw stowers 39 lean frame and lack of blocking as a development project to meet the two way prerequisite their system requires stowers is now sidelined and so is depth tight end grant calcaterra who went on injured reserve aug 30 with a back injury the eagles placed stowers on ir with hamstring and quadriceps injuries the day before the regular season opener he must miss at least four games but his tepid progress before the injury casts doubt on how much he can contribute in 2026 roseman emphasized a 34 long term view 34 when discussing stowers at the end of training camp the eagles are still acting on that view they placed ertz in a locker next to stowers supplying young talent with veteran mentors is an organizational staple 34 i don 39 t think it 39 s an accident that they put me here 34 ertz said 34 everyone 39 s got a superpower in this league 34 ertz said of stowers 34 and he 39 s got to play to his superpower and i 39 m looking forward to helping him kind of unlock that mentally physically to be at his best 34 ertz was the eagles 39 most available option in their contingency plan ertz made his interest in a return to philly known throughout the offseason the eagles appeared cautious on the same day roseman addressed stowers 39 status with reporters he acknowledged that he 39 d spoken with ertz 34 over a period of time 34 to maintain their relationship and understand where ertz was in his recovery he balanced praise for ertz by calling him 34 one of the greatest tight ends to play the game 34 with a note that he was 34 excited about the tight ends that we have here 34 the tact behind roseman 39 s words reflected the politics at play in 2021 ertz was then at the same stage in his career as goedert is now ertz secured the contract he 39 d coveted in arizona five years later with ertz wanting to return to philly and the eagles wanting proven depth a reunion made sense 34 everything 39 s discussed everything has a plan 34 sirianni said 34 that 39 s what i appreciate so much about howie everything 39 s thought out everything 39 s got a plan and here we are today in the situation we 39 re in and zach being here i 39 m excited about that opportunity for him 34 the eagles have friday and saturday practices before they must make a decision about ertz if they aim to dress three tight ends against the bears their only other option right now is promoting josiah deguara from the practice squad deguara a seventh year veteran played in 12 games for the cardinals in 2025 in a blocking oriented role but ertz underlined that he isn 39 t yet even on the active roster it 39 s up to the coaches to decide whether his play in practice merits a return on monday night 34 it 39 s about going out there and proving that i can make a difference in the game 34 ertz said 34 if i can 39 t make a difference in the game then i shouldn 39 t be out there 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Ravens vs. Cowboys: Three must-know storylines for NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro
news_mentions.description: Is Ravens RB Derrick Henry about to run over the Cowboys once again? Jeremy Bergman breaks down three must-know storylines for Sunday's game between Baltimore and Dallas in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back in brazil this week for the third straight season once again pitting two high profile clubs in front of some of the world s most passionate fans it s a recipe for electric football but there are a few notable differences this time around for one after two years in sao paulo the league is making its regular season debut in brazil s second largest city rio de janeiro and its most iconic venue the maracana home to some of the most memorable moments in brazilian sporting history two world cups with unfortunate exits for the selecao the 2016 summer olympics the maracana used to hold nearly 200 000 spectators jerry jones cowboys who play in one of the nfl s largest stadiums will feel right at home in the cavernous confines the capacity is just over 73 000 nowadays but the roar undoubtedly remains another change after being played in friday week 1 island windows in 2024 and 25 this year s brazil game will kick off at 4 25 p m et on a sunday right in the middle of a four game late slate no offense to the cardinals 49ers vikings buccaneers raiders and saints but most eyes will be on baltimore and dallas in rio and deservedly so boasting two of the most explosive offenses and marketable quarterbacks in today s nfl the ravens and cowboys enter their international outing with somewhat disappointing 1 1 records and a lot to prove after a week 1 road rout of indianapolis baltimore blew a second half lead at home against the saints in week 2 the cowboys conversely were run over by the rival giants in week 1 only to crush the visiting commanders the following sunday both considered playoff division and super bowl contenders baltimore and dallas have a lot to work out in the season s early goings and will be doing so this week in unfamiliar territory the ravens are playing only their third ever game overseas while the cowboys will be embarking on just their second international voyage three must know storylines 1 is derrick henry due for another big day vs dallas d tractorcito bem vindo ao brasil the ravens running back hulking at 6 foot 3 and 252 pounds is set up for a monster day at the maracana as long as baltimore leans on the back in crunch time through two weeks henry ranked second in the league with 212 rushing yards while tying for the nfl lead with four scores on the ground the tailback might have been even more productive if he had received more than five carries in the second half of the ravens week 2 loss when the saints came back from an 11 point first half deficit the perfect remedy after last week s disappointing finish could be a date with the cowboys defense led by first year dc christian parker dallas hasn t stopped a nosebleed through two weeks ranking 29th in yards allowed per game 391 5 and 30th in rushing yards allowed per game 173 5 the cowboys are also dead last in third down conversion rate allowed 68 0 a bruiser like henry and an escape artist like lamar jackson are nightmares for a defense like dallas which struggled to contain cam skattebo and jaxson dart in week 1 allowing the giants to control the clock and salt away a win while the cowboys offense had two second half possessions just two years ago henry rolled over dallas to the tune of 174 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns with jackson tallying 87 yards and a td on the ground as well will the ravens runners have similar outings in the southern hemisphere this sunday 2 can the cowboys continue to roll offensively if week 1 was a liar as they say was week 2 the truth for the cowboys it s tough to say this early in the season with dallas jekyll and hyde offense the cowboys scored on seven of their eight drives against washington in their home opener and have consistently cooked defenses under brian schottenheimer all of which made their season opening dud in east rutherford see 244 total yards all the more surprising after the ravens struggled to defend through the air against chris olave juwan johnson and devaughn vele in week 2 dallas will look to hammer baltimore s dbs with a heavy dose of ceedee lamb and george pickens a dynamic duo that only occasionally has a case of the dropsies and tight end jake ferguson the key for the ravens will be getting pressure on dak prescott so far this season the qb has been beating the blitz with ease 78 3 completion percentage third in nfl but when under pressure he has struggled 50 his lowest mark since 2019 per nfl pro baltimore s defense boasts a 43 8 pressure rate this season the fifth highest in the nfl and has pressured qbs on 65 0 of third down dropbacks highest in the league if dallas can avoid third and long situations it may have a field day against baltimore but jesse minter s defense led by kyle hamilton roquan smith trey hendrickson and potentially nnamdi madubuike who might make his season debut on sunday will do its best to keep the cowboys behind the chains 3 play action advantage for baltimore playing off its success in the ground game baltimore could enjoy a big day in the play fake game against dallas through two games this season lamar jackson has completed 13 of his 18 play action pass attempts for an nfl high 229 yards while also taking off to run on four play action dropbacks for 36 scramble rush yards the top total in the league off play action per nfl pro meanwhile his opponent on sunday has allowed qbs to target a receiver with 3 plus yards of separation on 12 of 17 play action attempts this season 70 6 the second highest rate in the nfl and has also yielded a league high 61 scramble yards on play action dropbacks 24 more than the next closest team while jackson is making fewer plays on designed runs this year he remains the nfl s great improviser the dallas defense is determined to stay disciplined but with the unit struggling against play action baltimore s two time league mvp could break open the game either through the air or on the ground total football in brazil s cathedral of futebol

news_mentions.headline: Bengals backup Joe Flacco doesn't expect trade to Giants after Jaxson Dart injury: 'Not true'
news_mentions.description: Bengals backup Joe Flacco’s ties to Giants coach John Harbaugh make the 41-year-old an interesting trade target. However, Flacco doesn’t plan on leaving the Queen City.
news_mentions.body_text: with jaxson dart out for the season and jameis winston struggling in his stead the rumor mill has churned out potential trade options for the new york giants should winston continue to look like a player who spent his summer on the world cup tour cincinnati bengals backup joe flacco s ties to john harbaugh from their time in baltimore make the 41 year old an interesting target however flacco doesn t plan on leaving the queen city it s obviously not real and not true flacco told kelsey conway of the cincinnati enquirer about trade rumors but it was good enough to get people like certain friends of mine to get them to text me hey i ll see you in new york i was like no guys you won t that s not true given joe burrow s injury history it makes little to no sense for the bengals to trade flacco even with a veteran like josh johnson on the practice squad if burrow goes down for a spell flacco is the best option to keep things afloat i just get a kick out of it he said i haven t really given it too much thought at this point last year flacco wasn t aware he was being traded from cleveland to cincinnati so anything can happen but there is minuscule incentive for the bengals to trade their top backup or the giants to part with an asset for a 41 year old who isn t going to change their season long trajectory regardless of his relationship with the head coach in these cases it s not up to me flacco said i m on the cincinnati bengals and because of that that s my focus being here doing the things that i need to do to get better each day while i m here make sure i m absorbing the game plan and all of those things i get a little bit of a kick out of it but it s kind out of my hands i m a cincinnati bengal and i m doing everything i can to get ready for the pittsburgh steelers the giants recently gave winston an extension he ll get a chance to run the offense before new york hits the panic button if winston is so awful that big blue is desperate for qb help the season is probably lost anyway backups with experience like flacco will always be named as potential candidates whenever a starter goes down just because there are speculative rumors doesn t mean a trade makes sense for either party

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs want to lighten Kenneth Walker's workload after 56 touches in two games
news_mentions.description: Kenneth Walker III has rejuvenated the Kansas City offense, bringing a tackle-breaking ground element that had been missing. The Chiefs, however, know they mustn’t grind the RB into the ground.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth walker has rejuvenated the kansas city chiefs offense bringing a tackle breaking ground element that had been missing the chiefs however know they mustn t grind the rb into the ground coach andy reid said this week the club would like to reduce walker s workload a little bit heading into week 3 walker led the nfl with 290 rushing yards and 369 scrimmage yards in 2026 two touchdowns after thursday night football bijan robinson now leads with 349 and 467 respectively walker s rushing yard tally marks the most by any nfl player through two weeks since c j spiller in 2012 292 walker is on pace for 2 465 rush yards which would be an nfl record by 360 yards he s also tied with jahmyr gibbs with 56 scrimmage touches we re lucky to have him running backs coach demarco murray said thursday via espn he s a great leader and he s done a great job for us he s prepared himself for this workload since the spring coach reid puts a great training camp together and the long drive drill is legendary around here walker likes the ball a lot walker s 369 scrimmage yards are the second most by a player in his first two games with a team in the super bowl era only billy sims had more with the lions the back has forced 29 missed tackles in 2026 per next gen stats most through two weeks in ngs era the key is balance and ensuring walker who never played a full 17 game slate before last season remains healthy to that end the chiefs plan to give rookie emmett johnson who has also flashed tackle breaking acumen more run we just want to continue to make sure we re bringing our rookies along the right way offensive coordinator eric bieniemy said thursday emmett s role is to continue to grow as the season progresses what you don t want to do when you re raising some of these young players is put them in a situation where it could be detrimental to them you want them feeling free and confident through two games johnson has generated 10 rushes for 39 yards and four catches for 64 yards 103 scrimmage yards the plan is to get the rookie more carries starting with sunday s game against the miami dolphins i want kenneth to get into a groove and it s hard to kind of take him out murray said but emmett s done a great job and he s still learning he ll continue to get more opportunities i ve just got to pull the trigger and get no 9 walker out of there and put no 10 johnson in there

news_mentions.headline: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? Plus, three disappointing units
news_mentions.description: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks provides game plans for two of the NFL's toughest assignments. Plus, three wildly disappointing units in the young season.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three units experiencing serious struggles in the young season but first a look at a prolific offense and a devastating defense the season is only a few weeks old but no units have shined brighter than the buffalo bills offense and minnesota vikings defense joe brady and brian flores have unlocked their jimmys and joes by cleverly deploying the x s and o s on the grassy chessboard with both teams sitting atop their respective divisions at 2 0 the rest of the league is trying to figure out how to slow down the bills explosive offense and block the vikings blitz happy defense after digging into the all 22 film on nfl pro here are three keys to tackling two of the league s toughest assignments in 2026 three keys to stopping the bills offense 1 play keep away reducing the number of possessions buffalo receives is the best way to neutralize one of the league s most explosive offenses josh allen and co cannot score if they don t have the ball so a ball control strategy designed to shrink the game is the no 1 objective for a team facing this juggernaut this season the bills are averaging just 28 44 in time of possession 24th in the nfl while running 60 5 offensive plays per game 15th but they lead the league in scoring 38 5 ppg and rank second in total offense 427 5 ypg given the bills explosive potential and efficient production opposing coaches should build game plans around a complementary football strategy that emphasizes a slower offensive pace from taking the play clock down to five seconds or fewer before snapping the ball to staying in bounds on perimeter runs every offensive player must understand the turtle approach being employed to keep buffalo s high powered offense on the sidelines by reducing total possessions and plays opponents can ramp up pressure on the bills offense to do more with less although the ultra efficient unit has set off fireworks with limited possessions thus far the slowdown strategy gives opponents a better chance to win with stops and turnovers which are at a higher premium in a low possession game 2 make josh allen win from the pocket the 2024 nfl mvp is one of the league s most dangerous playmakers having eclipsed 35 total touchdowns for six straight seasons in each of the past three campaigns the 6 foot 5 237 pounder has logged at least 25 passing tds and 12 rushing scores a feat no other quarterback has ever accomplished although he is an explosive pocket passer with exceptional range allen is an unstoppable force when he uses his athleticism and running skills to create big plays on the perimeter whether picking up first downs on designed quarterback runs or impromptu scrambles run around tosses the four time pro bowler terrorizes defenses when he flees the pocket to counter his big play potential defensive coordinators must implement a pass rush plan that has everyone rush to the depth of his drop in order to restrict escape lanes in the pocket additionally pass rushers must work together to create a coordinated mush rush as opposed to operating as independent contractors attacking no 17 with random 1 on 1 pass rush maneuvers defensive coordinators also need to account for allen s impact on designed quarterback runs particularly in goal line and short yardage situations the supersized playmaker has a knack for moving the chains and or finding the paint on quarterback powers following direct snaps or flash fakes in the backfield defensive play callers must assign a defender to the quarterback to prevent the bills from capitalizing on the plus one advantage created by a running qb finally the bills signal caller must be kept in check in the gotta have it moments when he is prone to leave the pocket while operating in playmaker mode allen has routinely relied on his improvisational skills on third down in the red zone and in two minute situations so defenders must be aware of his tendencies in those moments to minimize his impact while containing allen is easier said than done the most successful defenses against buffalo have made the superstar a one dimensional threat 3 take away the middle of the field the bills made a blockbuster trade in march to acquire a wr1 in dj moore but the team s dynamic tight end duo of dalton kincaid and dawson knox is the linchpin of the passing game kincaid in particular has emerged as buffalo s top pass catcher with his speed quickness and ball skills posing problems for linebackers and safeties matching up with him the 2023 first rounder leads the team in targets 14 receptions 12 and receiving yards 225 doing most of his damage on short and intermediate routes between the numbers in addition kincaid is a sneaky vertical threat who routinely cruises past defenders on seam routes since 2024 allen has totaled 11 completions for 253 yards and three touchdowns when targeting kincaid on open downfield throws 3 plus yards of target separation and 10 plus air yards per next gen stats given the playmaking tight end s impact opponents must shut down the middle of the field and force allen to find completions elsewhere by jamming the middle with a robber safety or utilizing bracket coverage with a linebacker and safety assigned to kincaid the defense can put the onus on moore and others to win their 1 on 1 matchups on the perimeter despite the fanfare around moore s arrival and his eye popping yards per catch average thus far 20 0 the bills inside out passing game is nearly impossible to stop when their no 1 tight end is getting loose over the middle by limiting kincaid s impact and forcing buffalo to rely on a complementary pass catcher to carry the aerial attack opponents can hope the tactics disrupt a well oiled machine that is already in midseason form three keys to surviving the vikings defense 1 crack the code vikings dc brian flores exotic pressures and unorthodox coverage patterns are masked by a clever series of pre snap disguises that befuddle quarterbacks at the line of scrimmage with the organized chaos creating hesitation and doubt for novice and experienced passers opposing coaching staffs should operate at a quicker pace to give their quarterbacks access to the offensive coordinator at the line of scrimmage communication devices shut off with 15 seconds left on the play clock and allow for double cadence calls qb barks out the signals and fakes a snap count before re assessing the defense and repeating the process with a different play call based on the defensive look those kinds of tactics force the vikings to reveal their plans while plenty of quarterbacks have attempted these techniques against flores aggressive approach the vikings snowflake game plans make it hard to predict how the defense will align after the snap as a zone blitz heavy outfit minnesota s d balances ultra aggressive six man hot pressures with three man rushes drop eight coverages consequently quarterbacks are lured into a high stakes guessing game that ultimately produces mistakes and turnovers against a unit that relies heavily on blitzes and chaos a quicker tempo produces more vanilla defensive looks due to communication and alignment assignment issues with so many tempo ploys available to offensive coordinators the best game plan should mix no huddle sugar huddle and fast break tactics that eliminate the time minnesota needs to run intricate pre snap disguises 2 win early downs with quicks screens and runs if opponents want to avoid the chaotic pressures flores likes to employ on third down they must stay on schedule by gaining 4 plus yards on first down using a mix of quick throws screens and downhill runs to keep minnesota defenders guessing considering minnesota s ridiculous blitz rate thus far this season 75 percent nearly 30 percent more than anyone else the ball has to come out quickly to keep the quarterback upright in the pocket although the vikings utilize vision and break blitz zones with defenders keying the quarterback catch and throw routes are the best way to consistently pick up 5 yard gains whether targeting running backs tight ends or wide receivers on swings quick outs hitches or slants the high percentage throws create a series of 1 on 1 tackling drills that test the defense s prowess in space moreover it gives the offense a chance to produce some chunk plays on easy throws given how challenging it is to tackle early in the season due to limited reps in preseason and training camp it makes sense to test minnesota s defensive backs on the perimeter if a few quick passes turn into big plays after missed tackles the ultra aggressive play caller might have to scale back some of his exotics to settle down his troops beyond the screens and quick game strategies opponents must run the ball at the vikings despite minnesota s heavy use of six man pressures that snuff out many running plays a persistent ground attack keeps the game plan from turning into a one dimensional call sheet more suited to a 7 on 7 passing competition the vikings rank 13th in rush defense with opponents averaging 100 yards per game on the ground although those numbers are solid for a defense that aims to harass quarterbacks and create turnovers it suggests opponents might be able to carve out some room on the ground with early down runs to stay on schedule against a d that wants to create chaos at every turn 3 take your shot flores is unapologetically aggressive following a live by the blitz die by the blitz creed that scares some offensive play callers into submission however the aggressive pressure tactics create plenty of big play opportunities if the protection holds up at the line of scrimmage with that in mind quarterbacks must attack the pressure with scripted deep balls that punish the vikings for leaving their defensive backs on islands whether using max protection out of run heavy sets on second third and short situations or taking a shot on first down opponents must consistently threaten the vikes downfield to keep their defensive backs from squatting on short and intermediate routes moreover the selective deep shots could make flores reconsider some of his choices if his unit surrenders a big play or two early in the contest remember the packers raced out to a lead against the vikings in week 1 by taking a few shots to christian watson tucker kraft and jonnu smith by flipping the script on the vikings and attacking their pressure with long bombs opponents can dictate the terms to the defense and turn minnesota s aggressive approach into a favorable situation three wildly disappointing units can they be fixed while the bills offense and vikings defense have opened the 2026 campaign in style several units have seriously stumbled out of the gates i d like to spotlight three that have been particularly awful
